jobs.title: System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Per rafforzare il nostro team di ingegneri, stiamo cercando un System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) per lavorare sui sistemi di controllo e protezione nel campo delle sottostazioni di rete elettrica. L'apertura, l'orientamento del cliente e l'innovazione sono fattori chiave di successo nel nostro ambiente di lavoro. Dovresti essere un giocatore di squadra che collabora a diversi livelli organizzativi in un ambiente interculturale. Se ti piace combinare competenze tecniche con un forte focus del cliente, questa è un'opportunità per te! I professionisti della cura precoce sono anche benvenuti da applicare. Benvenuti nella nostra squadra! Come farai ad avere un impatto In questa posizione impegnativa, si progettano sistemi di controllo sottostazione (SCADA) per switchgear ad alta e media tensione in conformità con gli ultimi standard tecnologici come IEC 61850, IEC 104 e altri protocolli Integrerai i sistemi, inclusa la parametrizzazione della struttura di comunicazione basata su Ethernet Inoltre, implementerai funzioni e applicazioni software specifiche per il progetto, eseguirai test e coordinate interfacce Supportando la messa in loco presso le strutture in tutta la Svizzera è anche parte del tuo ruolo Supporterai il project manager in materia tecnica e coordinate sia i clienti che i partner esterni Potrai creare manuali operativi su misura per le esigenze del cliente Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettrica, o una qualifica equivalente Conoscenze di base di sistemi di controllo e protezione, sistemi RTU, o sistemi di automazione di processo è un vantaggio Hai conoscenze di base di sicurezza informatica e architettura di rete Accanto a forti capacità di comunicazione e spirito di squadra, è necessario dimostrare la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere la responsabilità Fluent tedesco (spoken e scritto) è necessario. Le buone competenze in inglese sono essenziali; lingue aggiuntive come il francese sono un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Um unser Engineering-Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU), der an Steuerungs- und Schutzsystemen im Bereich der Umspannwerke arbeitet. Offenheit, Kundenorientierung und Innovation sind zentrale Erfolgsfaktoren in unserem Arbeitsumfeld. Sie sollten ein Teamplayer sein, der auf verschiedenen organisatorischen Ebenen in einem interkulturellen Umfeld zusammenarbeitet. Wenn Sie gerne technisches Know-how mit einem starken Kundenfokus verbinden, ist dies eine Chance für Sie! Auch Early Career Professionals können sich gerne bewerben. Willkommen in unserem Team! Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden In dieser herausfordernden Position konstruieren Sie Substation Control Systeme (SCADA) für Hoch- und Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen nach den neuesten Technologienormen wie IEC 61850, IEC 104 und anderen Protokollen. Sie integrieren die Systeme, einschließlich der Parametrierung der Ethernet-basierten Kommunikationsstruktur Darüber hinaus implementieren Sie projektspezifische Funktionen und Softwareanwendungen, führen Tests durch und koordinieren Schnittstellen Die Inbetriebnahme vor Ort in Einrichtungen in der ganzen Schweiz ist ebenfalls Teil Ihrer Rolle Sie unterstützen den Projektleiter in technischen Fragen und koordinieren sowohl Kunden als auch interne Partner Sie erstellen Betriebshandbücher, die auf die Kundenanforderungen zugeschnitten sind Ihr Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Energietechnik, Elektrotechnik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation Grundkenntnisse in Steuerungs- und Schutzsystemen, RTU-Systemen oder Prozessautomatisierungssystemen sind von Vorteil Sie verfügen über Grundkenntnisse in Cybersicherheit und Netzwerkarchitektur Neben starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist müssen Sie die Fähigkeit nachweisen, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen Fließend Deutsch (gesprochen und geschrieben) ist erforderlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche Sprachen wie Französisch sind ein Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénieurs, nous cherchons un ingénieur système (SCADA\/RTU) pour travailler sur les systèmes de contrôle et de protection dans le domaine des sous-stations du réseau électrique. L'ouverture, l'orientation client et l'innovation sont des facteurs clés de réussite dans notre environnement de travail. Vous devriez être un joueur d'équipe qui collabore à différents niveaux organisationnels dans un environnement interculturel. Si vous aimez combiner l'expertise technique avec une forte concentration client, c'est une opportunité pour vous! Les professionnels en début de carrière sont également invités à postuler. Bienvenue dans notre équipe ! Comment vous ferez un impact Dans cette position difficile, vous concevrez des systèmes de commande sous-station (SCADA) pour les commutateurs à haute et moyenne tension conformément aux dernières normes technologiques telles que IEC 61850, IEC 104 et d'autres protocoles Vous intégrerez les systèmes, y compris la paramétrisation de la structure de communication Ethernet De plus, vous mettrez en œuvre des fonctions spécifiques au projet et des applications logicielles, réaliserez des tests et coordonnerz des interfaces. Vous créerez des manuels d'exploitation adaptés aux besoins du client Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie de l'énergie, génie électrique ou une qualification équivalente Connaissance de base des systèmes de contrôle et de protection, systèmes RTU, ou systèmes d'automatisation de processus est un avantage Vous avez une connaissance de base de la cybersécurité et de l'architecture de réseau Outre de solides compétences en communication et l'esprit d'équipe, vous devez démontrer la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et prendre des responsabilités. De bonnes compétences en anglais sont essentielles; d'autres langues comme le français sont un avantage Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Scientist in Physics and Scientific Programming (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!  How you'll make an impact   You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity   More about us     At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.  Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo e supportando processi produttivi innovativi. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Werden Sie bei Hitachi, Ltd. als Geräteingenieur tätig und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Optimierung und Wartung von Produktionsanlagen, um hohe Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz sicherzustellen. Sie arbeiten in einer kollaborativen Umgebung, tragen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bei und unterstützen innovative Fertigungsprozesse. Wie Sie etwas bewirken können: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Änderungen und Upgrades an vorhandenen Fertigungsanlagen, um Effizienz, Ertrag und Sicherheit zu verbessern. Führen Sie routinemäßige Wartungs-, Fehlerbehebungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an komplexen Fertigungsmaschinen und -systemen durch. Analysieren Sie Leistungsdaten der Anlagen, um Trends zu erkennen, Ausfälle vorherzusagen und vorbeugende Maßnahmen zu implementieren. Arbeiten Sie mit Produktions-, F&E- und Qualitätsteams zusammen, um anlagenbezogene Probleme zu lösen und Prozesse zu optimieren. Erstellen und pflegen Sie Dokumentationen für den Anlagenbetrieb, Wartungsverfahren und technische Spezifikationen Beschaffung der erforderlichen Komponenten und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards und Umweltvorschriften. Unterstützung bei der Auswahl, Installation und Qualifizierung neuer Fertigungsanlagen. Ihr Hintergrund. Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik. Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Anlagentechnik in einer Fertigungsumgebung. Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von mechanischen, elektrischen und Steuerungssystemen. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Maschinen zu beheben und Fehlerursachen zu identifizieren. Vertrautheit mit Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden. Starke Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu arbeiten. Englisch ist Pflicht, Deutsch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Fluid Dynamics for Circuit Breakers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative R&D team shaping high voltage technologies. You will contribute to the simulation and analysis of thermo-fluid phenomena relevant to switching performance and thermal behavior in gas circuit breakers. The work combines numerical simulation, data analysis, and engineering evaluation, supporting ongoing product development activities. How you'll make an impact Conduct structural analysis by hand calculations and finite element simulations on electrical machines for a variety of load cases (e.g. lifting, seismic, short circuit, shock, fatigue etc.) Perform experimental test for the validation of finite element models through comparison with experimental results Conduct experimental testing campaign for the diagnostic of structure-borne and air-borne noise of electrical equipment Ensure that all structural designs complie with relevant industry codes, standards and regulations Prepare detailed structural reports to be delivered to our customers Assist the design engineers in the development of transformer and reactors structural components Support other departments in preparing for customer technical meetings and design reviews Your background Master's degree in mechanical engineering or similar field Proficiency with numerical and analytical calculation software such as ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB Knowledge of relevant building codes (Eurocode) and regulations Experience with noise and vibration measurements and relevant data post-processing Work experience in the transformer industry as well as knowledge of transformer manufacturing process, assembly procedures and best practices is a plus Experience with CAD software such as CREO and Inventor is an advantage Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and written Ability to work effectively both individually and in a team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Process Improvement 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is looking for a dynamic and experienced Project Manager Process Improvement to drive strategic optimization initiatives across business units. In this role, you will enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen overall operational performance through structured process improvements and digital transformation.  How you'll make an impact  Lead end-to-end process improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and A3 methodologies   Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics with stakeholders   Analyse current processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities   Develop and implement scalable process solutions leveraging best practices and digital tools and drive change management, including workshops and trainings to ensure adoption   Lead CI method trainings (e.g. A3 problem solving)  Monitor project progress, risks, and performance, and report to senior management   Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, finance, IT, and other stakeholders   Identify opportunities for automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement  Your background  Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master's is a plus)   Minimum 5 years of experience in project management with focus on process improvement   Minimum 3 year of experience as continues improvement responsible  Proven track record in delivering complex process optimization initiatives  Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) certification   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills   Experience working in cross-functional and international environments  Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and evolving business environment  English is mandatory, German beneficial More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility for the development and delivery of innovative products and technologies. You will leverage your technical expertise to lead key aspects of projects, ensuring that solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance while adhering to strict deadlines and budgets. This is a high-impact role with excellent opportunities for career growth and development. How you will make an impact   Apply your expertise in technologies, tools, and methods to solve complex industrial challenges and develop innovative products and solutions Contribute to shaping technology strategies and project portfolios, helping guide the direction of the organization Work on complex engineering tasks using advanced and innovative techniques to deliver impactful R&D results Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues Stay up to date with key trends and technologies in your field and proactively drive improvements in operations and customer satisfaction Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team Support business operations and customers as a technical expert and represent the team in internal and external engineering forums Contribute to intellectual property strategy, identify risks, and support effective risk management in R&D projects Your background   Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field 5–10 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components Strong expertise in the design and development of high voltage components (experience with bushings is an advantage) Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken Solid understanding of business processes and R&D environments Proven experience in project management and cross-functional collaboration Basic understanding of intellectual property considerations in R&D More about us   At Hitachi Energy, you will work in an international and collaborative environment, contributing to innovative technologies that shape the future of energy systems. This role offers the opportunity to address real-world challenges in power grids and sustainability, combining advanced engineering with impactful applications. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Polymechaniker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich High Voltage Products der Hitachi Energy ist weltweit anerkannt als Spezialist für Anlagen der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. Innerhalb des Bereichs High Voltage Products ist der Bereich Hochstromsysteme verantwortlich für Entwicklung, Verkauf, Produktion und den Service von Generatorleistungsschaltern. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung der Montage von PGHV-Produkten gemäss den Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen aus den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen Arbeiten nach Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenaufträgen, technischen Unterlagen, Schemata, Checklisten und Arbeitsplänen Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgelegten QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellenerkennung und -behebung sowie Meldung an den Vorgesetzten Einhaltung des festgelegten Ablaufs zur Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker\/in Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Selbständige, zuverlässige und saubere Arbeitsweise Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden dein Profil ab Mehr über uns    Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: La divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione di Hitachi Energy è riconosciuta a livello mondiale come specialista nei sistemi di trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. All'interno della divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione, la divisione Sistemi ad alta tensione è responsabile per lo sviluppo, le vendite, la produzione e il servizio degli interruttori a circuito generatore. È possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo effettuando l'assemblaggio dei prodotti PGHV in conformità con le specifiche e gli obiettivi delle procedure di garanzia della qualità e delle istruzioni di lavoro Lavorare secondo documenti di lavoro come ordini del cliente, documenti tecnici, schemi, liste di controllo e orari di lavoro Montaggio tempestivo ed economico delle assemblee e dei sistemi di commutazione Rispetto al rilevamento e correzione delle linee guida QS definite, nonché la notifica al supervisore Compliance con il processo definito per la risoluzione dei problemi Questo ti porta con completato l'apprendistato professionale come un'esperienza polimeccanica / / in esperienza pratica e teorica nell'assemblaggio di macchine Buona conoscenza nel parlare e nella scrittura Buona conoscenza nella lettura dei documenti di disegno e dei documenti di lavoro Autolavoro, affidabile e pulito metodi di lavoro Responsabilità- e qualità-cosciente personalità Flessibilità, resistenza e determinazione arrotondare il tuo profilo Maggiori informazioni su di noi Hitachi Energy sta per tecnologie innovative e soluzioni energetiche sostenibili in tutto il mondo. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un posto di lavoro sicuro in una società orientata al futuro, emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e apprezzativo e benefici sociali attraenti.
descriptionByLocale.en: The High Voltage Products division of Hitachi Energy is recognized worldwide as a specialist in power transmission and distribution systems. Within the High Voltage Products division, the High Voltage Systems division is responsible for the development, sales, production and service of generator circuit breakers. You can achieve this by carrying out the assembly of PGHV products in accordance with the specifications and objectives from the quality assurance procedures and work instructions Work according to working papers such as customer orders, technical documents, schemes, checklists and work schedules Timely and economical assembly of the assemblies and switch systems Compliance with the defined QS guidelines vulnerability detection and correction as well as notification to the supervisor Compliance with the defined process for troubleshooting This brings you with completed vocational apprenticeship as a polymechanic / / into practical and theoretical experience in machine assembly Good knowledge in speaking and writing Good knowledge in reading drawing documents and working papers Self-employed, reliable and clean working methods Responsibility- and quality-conscious personality Flexibility, endurance and determination round off your profile More about us Hitachi Energy stands for innovative technologies and sustainable energy solutions worldwide. With us, you can expect a secure workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and appreciative working environment and attractive social benefits.

jobs.title: Project Manager Product Implementation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will take ownership of the successful implementation of new and transferred products, ensuring they are ready for market launch and customer installation. You will play a key role in aligning cross-functional teams, driving operational readiness, and ensuring high-quality execution across engineering, procurement, production, and delivery. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can shape processes, drive continuous improvement, and contribute directly to the success of innovative GIS products. How you'll make an impact Lead end-to-end product implementation projects from initiation to closure Define scope, objectives, and deliverables with key stakeholders Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, and budgets Align and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure execution readiness Ensure completeness and accuracy of master data across all systems Monitor early production phases (test objects and zero series) to validate readiness Identify risks, drive mitigation actions, and ensure transparent communication Track production, assembly, and testing processes and drive continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field Minimum 5 years of project management experience, ideally in product implementation Proven experience delivering complex technical or industrial projects Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) Experience working in cross-functional and international environments Solid understanding of industrial product lifecycles; GIS experience is a plus Strong communication and stakeholder management skills PMP certification and knowledge of tools like MS Project or Jira are advantageous More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, assumerai la responsabilità dell'implementazione di successo di prodotti nuovi e trasferiti, assicurandoti che siano pronti per il lancio sul mercato e l'installazione da parte del cliente. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'allineamento dei team interfunzionali, nella promozione della prontezza operativa e nel garantire un'esecuzione di alta qualità nei settori di ingegneria, approvvigionamento, produzione e consegna. Questa posizione offre un ambiente dinamico in cui è possibile modellare i processi, promuovere il miglioramento continuo e contribuire direttamente al successo di prodotti GIS innovativi. Come avrai un impatto Guidare progetti di implementazione del prodotto end-to-end dall'inizio alla chiusura Definire ambito, obiettivi e risultati finali con le principali parti interessate Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto, tempistiche, risorse e budget Allineare e coordinare team interfunzionali per garantire la preparazione all'esecuzione Garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza dei dati master in tutti i sistemi Monitorare le prime fasi di produzione (oggetti di test e serie zero) per convalidare la preparazione Identificare i rischi, promuovere azioni di mitigazione e garantire una comunicazione trasparente Monitorare i processi di produzione, assemblaggio e test e promuovere il miglioramento continuo background Laurea in ingegneria, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti, idealmente nell'implementazione del prodotto Comprovata esperienza nella realizzazione di progetti tecnici o industriali complessi Forte conoscenza delle metodologie di gestione dei progetti (ad es. Agile, Waterfall) Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali Solida comprensione dei cicli di vita dei prodotti industriali; L'esperienza GIS è un vantaggio Forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione delle parti interessate La certificazione PMP e la conoscenza di strumenti come MS Project o Jira sono vantaggiose Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Implementierung neuer und übertragener Produkte und stellen sicher, dass diese für die Markteinführung und Installation beim Kunden bereit sind. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Ausrichtung funktionsübergreifender Teams, der Förderung der Betriebsbereitschaft und der Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Ausführung in den Bereichen Technik, Beschaffung, Produktion und Lieferung. Diese Position bietet ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem Sie Prozesse gestalten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorantreiben und direkt zum Erfolg innovativer GIS-Produkte beitragen können. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Leiten Sie End-to-End-Produktimplementierungsprojekte von der Initiierung bis zum Abschluss. Definieren Sie Umfang, Ziele und Ergebnisse mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern. Entwickeln und verwalten Sie Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets. Richten Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams aus und koordinieren Sie sie, um die Ausführungsbereitschaft sicherzustellen. Stellen Sie die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Stammdaten in allen Systemen sicher. Überwachen Sie frühe Produktionsphasen (Testobjekte und Nullserien), um die Bereitschaft zu validieren. Identifizieren Sie Risiken, treiben Sie Abhilfemaßnahmen voran und stellen Sie eine transparente Kommunikation sicher. Verfolgen Sie Produktions-, Montage- und Testprozesse und treiben Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Produktimplementierung Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Durchführung komplexer technischer oder industrieller Projekte Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Projektmanagementmethoden (z. B. Agile, Wasserfall) Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen Solides Verständnis der Lebenszyklen industrieller Produkte; GIS-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil. Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten. PMP-Zertifizierung und Kenntnisse von Tools wie MS Project oder Jira sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’alignement des équipes interfonctionnelles, dans la préparation opérationnelle et dans la garantie d’une exécution de haute qualité en matière d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de production et de livraison. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Internship in Sales Operations 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity  Join a collaborative team that values innovation and continuous improvement. In this role, you will support operational excellence and learn how a production unit works. You will gain hands-on experience with data visualization, process optimization, project support and sales operations.  The duration of the internship is minimum 6 months.  How you'll make an impact  Collaborate in development of a tool for preparing quotations and generating documents for offers, capturing the needs of the sales team and transferring them to the development team  Gather and consolidate informations from the team and structure the same in an internal web page\/sharepoint  Develop tools for price analysis  Assist Area Sales Managers in documentation during peak periods  Take on additional tasks aligned with your development goals  Your background  Enrolled or completed master's or bachelor's degree in a technical field  Interest in data collection, processes, and production environments  Basic knowledge of Visual Basic, Excel, Power BI\/ PowerApps (or willingness to learn)  Good English skills, both, written and spoken  Open-minded and proactive personality  More about us  We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Research Team Manager - Circuit Breaker (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact   You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided)   You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment   You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: R&D Designer 60% -100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development. In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD\/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D\/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production. Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich. How you'll make an impact   Take responsibility for the 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD\/PLM\/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality Your background   Successfully completed apprenticeship as Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent know-how in CAD\/PLM systems, ideally PTC CREO and PTC Windchill Good Knowledge in SAP\/Office High expectations on quality of work in all regards Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality Practically oriented and hands-on way of working Team-player, committed, willing to learn Good command of German both written and spoken

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione a Zurigo‑Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un progettista di ricerca e sviluppo per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo interruttori nell'ambito dello sviluppo di interruttori automatici ad alta tensione. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alle attività di progettazione e sviluppo del prodotto all'interno del nostro panorama CAD\/PLM per progetti di ricerca e sviluppo in corso. La posizione fa parte del team di sviluppo degli interruttori e lavora a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri responsabili di ricerca e sviluppo nell'ambito dei progetti di sviluppo prodotto. Sarai responsabile della creazione, della manutenzione e della qualità dei dati del modello 3D\/2D per i componenti e gli assiemi assegnati, supportando lo sviluppo del prodotto virtuale dalla fase di prototipo alla produzione in serie. Cerchi sfide tecniche in un ambiente di sviluppo frenetico? Afferra rapidamente argomenti tecnici e ti piace lavorare attraverso diversi punti di vista per raggiungere solide soluzioni tecniche? Ti piace risolvere compiti di progettazione complessi in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti? Allora questa posizione offre l'opportunità giusta per te. Unisciti al nostro team e contribuisci allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta tensione di alta qualità in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Come avrai un impatto Assumerti la responsabilità dell'implementazione 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM, dal concept design alla produzione in serie, nell'ambito di progetti di sviluppo prodotto su dispositivi di commutazione ad alta tensione Creare, modificare e analizzare la progettazione di componenti e assiemi selezionati di dispositivi di commutazione in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri di ricerca e sviluppo e collaborare e supportare altre parti interessate del progetto, come la catena di fornitura e la cura del prodotto Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi e attività relativi a CAD\/PLM\/SAP e promuovere la qualità complessiva del modello Il tuo background Completato con successo apprendistato come Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Eccellente know-how nei sistemi CAD\/PLM, idealmente PTC CREO e PTC Windchill Buona conoscenza di SAP\/Office Elevate aspettative sulla qualità del lavoro sotto tutti gli aspetti Personalità indipendente, proattiva e orientata agli obiettivi Modo di lavorare pratico e orientato alla pratica Giocatore di squadra, impegnato, disposto ad apprendere Buona padronanza del tedesco sia scritto che parlato

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte in Zürich-Oerlikon suchen wir einen F&E-Designer zur Verstärkung unseres Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams im Bereich der Entwicklung von Hochspannungs-Leistungsschaltern. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu Produktdesign- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten innerhalb unserer CAD/PLM-Landschaft für laufende F&E-Projekte bei. Die Position ist Teil des Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams und arbeitet im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten eng mit den verantwortlichen F&E-Ingenieuren zusammen. Sie sind für die Erstellung, Pflege und Qualität von 3D-/2D-Modelldaten für zugewiesene Komponenten und Baugruppen verantwortlich und unterstützen die virtuelle Produktentwicklung von der Prototypenphase bis zur Serienproduktion. Suchen Sie technische Herausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen Entwicklungsumgebung? Sie haben ein schnelles Verständnis für technische Themen und haben Spaß daran, durch unterschiedliche Sichtweisen zu robusten technischen Lösungen zu gelangen? Lösen Sie gerne komplexe Konstruktionsaufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren? Dann bietet diese Position genau das Richtige für Sie. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und tragen Sie in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich zur Entwicklung hochwertiger Hochspannungsprodukte bei. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die 3D-/2D-CAD-/PLM-Implementierung vom Konzeptdesign bis zur Serienproduktion im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten für Hochspannungsschaltgeräte. Erstellen, modifizieren und analysieren Sie das Design ausgewählter Komponenten und Baugruppen von Schaltgeräten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit F&E-Ingenieuren und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Projektbeteiligten zusammen und unterstützen Sie sie, z. B. Lieferkette und Produktpflege. Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CAD-/PLM-/SAP-bezogenen Prozesse und Aktivitäten bei und fördern Sie die Gesamtmodellqualität. Ihr Hintergrund. Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Hervorragende Kenntnisse in CAD\/PLM-Systemen, idealerweise PTC CREO und PTC Windchill Gute Kenntnisse in SAP\/Office Hoher Anspruch an die Arbeitsqualität in allen Belangen Selbstständige, proaktive und zielorientierte Persönlichkeit Praxisorientierte und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise Teamplayer, engagiert, lernwillig Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Pour notre division Produits haute tension à Zurich‑Oerlikon, nous recherchons un concepteur R&D pour renforcer notre équipe de développement d'interrupteurs dans le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez aux activités de conception et de développement de produits au sein de notre paysage CAO\/PLM pour les projets de R&D en cours. Le poste fait partie de l'équipe de développement d'interrupteurs et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D responsables des projets de développement de produits. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la maintenance et de la qualité des données de modèles 3D\/2D pour les composants et assemblages assignés, prenant en charge le développement de produits virtuels depuis la phase de prototype jusqu'à la production en série. Êtes-vous à la recherche de défis techniques dans un environnement de développement au rythme rapide ? Vous maîtrisez rapidement les sujets techniques et aimez travailler à travers différents points de vue pour parvenir à des solutions techniques robustes ? Aimez-vous résoudre des tâches de conception complexes en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés ? Alors ce poste offre la bonne opportunité pour vous. Rejoignez notre équipe et contribuez au développement de produits haute tension de haute qualité dans un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous aurez un impact Assumer la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre de la CAO\/PLM 3D\/2D, de la conception à la production en série dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits sur des appareils de commutation haute tension. Créer, modifier et analyser la conception de composants et d'assemblages sélectionnés d'appareils de commutation en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D, et collaborer et soutenir les autres parties prenantes du projet, telles que la chaîne d'approvisionnement et l'entretien des produits. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et activités liés à la CAO\/PLM\/SAP et piloter la qualité globale du modèle. Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent savoir-faire en systèmes CAO\/PLM, idéalement PTC CREO et PTC Windchill Bonnes connaissances en SAP\/Office Attentes élevées en matière de qualité de travail à tous égards Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers les objectifs Orientation pratique et méthode de travail pratique Esprit d'équipe, engagé, désireux d'apprendre Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand à l'écrit et à l'oral

jobs.title: HSE Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ein sicheres und nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich Menschen entfalten können? Als unser HSE-Manager für PSC Schweiz übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Funktion Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umwelt und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung einer starken Sicherheitskultur in unserer gesamten Organisation. In dieser Position leiten und entwickeln Sie das HSE-Team und fungieren gleichzeitig als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für unser Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitern und externen Partnern zusammen, um höchste Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards zu gewährleisten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und spürbare Auswirkungen darauf zu haben, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter und Betriebe jeden Tag schützen. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Leiten Sie die HSE-Funktion und das HSE-Team für PSC Schweiz und fungieren Sie als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für das Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service-Logistikzentrum in Dietlikon. Sorgen Sie für ein starkes Engagement für Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards, Richtlinien, Managementsysteme und Verfahren. Kommunizieren Sie Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsinitiativen, -prozesse und -verfahren, um ein einheitliches Verständnis in der gesamten Organisation zu gewährleisten. Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung von Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsanforderungen und behandeln Sie Nichtkonformitäten gemäß festgelegten Verfahren. Unterstützen und leiten Sie Management, Vorgesetzte und Mitarbeiter bei der Unfallverhütung und fungieren Sie als Schnittstelle bei Bedarf mit Auftragnehmern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten. Implementieren und pflegen Sie das Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsmanagementsystem und stellen Sie bei Bedarf Qualitätseingaben sicher. Führen Sie Sicherheitsaudits durch, untersuchen Sie Unfälle, identifizieren Sie Grundursachen und überwachen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen. Bieten Sie Anleitung zu kompetenzbasierten Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsschulungen und leiten Sie HSE- und Nachhaltigkeitsprüfungen für Rüti und Dietlikon, um sicherzustellen, dass die Sicherungsaktivitäten abgeschlossen werden. Ihr Hintergrund. Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Führungspositionen in einem Industrieunternehmen, vorzugsweise im HSE-, Bau- oder Fabrikumfeld. Starke Führungspersönlichkeit und ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Verständnis für Gesundheit und Sicherheit an Projekt-/Kundenstandorten und die Rolle, die ein Sicherheitssystem bei der Verwaltung des Gesamtrisikoprofils eines Standorts spielt. Praktische „praktische“ Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Sicherheitssystemen mit der Fähigkeit, sich mit standortspezifischen Details zu befassen und Lösungen für komplexe Sicherheitsprobleme zu entwickeln. Kenntnisse über die OSHA-Gesetzgebung für Baustellen und Berufserfahrung in sicherheitsbezogenen Positionen. Internationale Erfahrung und interkulturelle Sensibilität sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starkem Engagement. Kenntnisse in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch von Vorteil und jeder anderen Sprache sind von Vorteil. Ungefähr 25 % Reiseaufwand. Mehr darüber Uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la création d'un environnement de travail sûr et durable où les gens peuvent s'épanouir ? En tant que responsable HSE pour PSC Suisse, vous assumerez l'entière responsabilité de la fonction Santé, Sécurité et Environnement et jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation d'une culture de sécurité solide au sein de notre organisation. Dans ce poste, vous dirigerez et développerez l'équipe HSE tout en agissant en tant que Site Lead Manager (HSE) pour notre centre de formation à Rüti et notre centre logistique de services à Dietlikon. Vous collaborerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les employés et les partenaires externes pour garantir les normes de santé et de sécurité les plus élevées, favoriser l'amélioration continue et avoir un impact tangible sur la façon dont nous protégeons nos employés et nos opérations au quotidien. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger la fonction et l'équipe HSE pour PSC Suisse et servir de Site Lead Manager (HSE) pour le centre de formation de Rüti et le centre logistique de service à Dietlikon Assurer un engagement fort envers les normes, directives, systèmes de gestion et procédures en matière de santé et de sécurité Communiquer les initiatives, les processus et les procédures en matière de santé et de sécurité pour garantir une compréhension uniforme dans toute l'organisation Surveiller le respect des exigences en matière de santé et de sécurité et gérer les non-conformités conformément aux procédures établies Aider et guider la direction, les superviseurs et les employés dans la prévention des accidents et agir en tant qu'interface avec les sous-traitants et les clients si nécessaire Mettre en œuvre et maintenir le système de gestion de la santé et de la sécurité et garantir la qualité si nécessaire Mener des audits de sécurité, enquêter sur les accidents, identifier les causes profondes et superviser les actions correctives Fournir des conseils sur la formation en matière de santé et de sécurité basée sur les compétences et diriger les examens HSE et de développement durable pour Rüti et Dietlikon, en garantissant que les activités d'assurance sont terminées. Votre expérience Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de direction dans une entreprise industrielle, de préférence dans un environnement HSE, de construction ou d'usine. et le rôle qu'un système de sécurité joue dans la gestion du profil de risque global d'un site Expérience pratique « pratique » dans le développement et la gestion de systèmes de sécurité avec la capacité d'approfondir les détails spécifiques au site et de développer des solutions à des problèmes de sécurité complexes. Connaissance de la législation OSHA pour les chantiers de construction et expérience professionnelle dans des postes liés à la sécurité Expérience internationale et sensibilité interculturelle et personnalité orientée solutions avec un fort engagement. La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et oral), de l'allemand (avantage) et de toute autre langue est un plus. performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et s'épanouir.

jobs.description:

Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How   you'll   make an impact Assist   in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users   in   navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help   maintain   IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems   operate   correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team.   Be   engaged in special projects where you   make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up,   set   up infrastructure,   set-up   of the meeting rooms)   Be engaged in special   on ‑ site   projects, such as office relocations,   changes   to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions   Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people   and with   following established procedures   and   you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Come Area Sales Manager, prenderete la proprietà di guidare la crescita aziendale all'interno della vostra regione assegnata e plasmare attivamente il nostro successo di mercato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e partner, posizionando il nostro portafoglio all'avanguardia e fornendo soluzioni che soddisfano requisiti tecnici e commerciali complessi. Entrando nel nostro team internazionale e altamente esperto, si acquisirà approfondimenti nel business ad alta tensione, contribuendo direttamente ai sistemi energetici sostenibili e affidabili. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per coniugare competenze tecniche con responsabilità commerciale e per dare un impatto tangibile sul futuro dell'energia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita per la tua regione assegnata, guidare la crescita sostenibile del business e aumentare la quota di mercato all'interno del portafoglio GIS - Costruire, mantenere ed espandere relazioni forti con i clienti chiave, gli EPC e i partner per identificare le opportunità di business e creare valore a lungo termine - Prendere la proprietà del ciclo di vendita completo, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e offrire la preparazione alla negoziazione e la chiusura di accordi di successo - Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne come l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto e i team di assistenza per fornire soluzioni competitive e orientate al cliente - Analizzare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività concorrenti per posizionare in modo proattivo il nostro portafoglio e rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato - Incremento dell'ordine e crescita dei ricavi, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità strategiche - Sostenere i clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei progetti, assicurando un alto livello di soddisfazione e individuando opportunità per ulteriori affari Il tuo sfondo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nelle vendite tecniche, gestione del conto chiave, o un ruolo simile rispetto al cliente, idealmente all'interno del settore energetico o industriale - Laurea (Bachelor o Master) in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo tecnico correlato, completato da una forte comprensione commerciale - una forte comprensione del mercato dell'energia, dell'industria manifatturiera o del business del sistema, idealmente con l'esposizione a sottostazioni o tecnologie di commutazione - Mindset Entrepreneurial con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, combinato con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e guidare argomenti in avanti - descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. jobs.title: Technical Buyer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Sei qualcuno che prende la proprieta', prospera in un ambiente frenetico e si diverte a fare un vero impatto? Allora applica oggi! Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito
• Requisiti - Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. - Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. - Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (attuazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). - Pianificazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. - Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. - Obblighi di invio nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di invio) concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call.
