jobs.title: Scientist - Reliability Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy! Join us as a Scientist in Reliability Engineering and become part of a passionate, dynamic, and innovative team driving the energy transition. We are seeking a skilled and motivated scientist to strengthen our research in the reliability of power grid components and systems. In this role, you will bridge theory and application—developing and validating cutting-edge methods and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future.   How you'll make an impact Drive innovation in reliability analysis, reliability improvement, and prognostics & health management for power grid components and systems Apply advanced techniques by combining reliability engineering, physics-of-failure insights, data analysis, mathematical modelling, and system tools to enhance the reliability of mission-critical equipment Collaborate globally with researchers and engineers across Hitachi Energy Research and business units to solve real-world challenges and identify opportunities for improvement Build strong networks within the company and with external partners, including universities, start-ups, and vendors Share your knowledge through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports   Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Solid experience in one or more of the following areas is required: statistical and probabilistic modelling (e.g., Bayesian inference, Monte Carlo simulations), mathematical modelling and simulation (e.g., Markov chains, Poisson processes, Petri nets), data science and machine learning Familiarity with reliability engineering methods or condition health monitoring in domains such as mechanical or electronics is a strong plus Proven track record of scientific publications in top-tier journals and conferences Fluency in English, both written and spoken   More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è uno specialista leader a livello mondiale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Nella nostra divisione servizi, lavoriamo per rendere i sistemi complessi efficienti, affidabili e a prova di futuro. Per sviluppare ulteriormente le nostre soluzioni digitali, stiamo cercando una persona impegnata nel campo dello sviluppo low-code con focus sulla piattaforma Microsoft Power. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a fianco di un team esperto per progettare applicazioni moderne e sviluppare le tue soluzioni che rendono i nostri processi più intelligenti e trasparenti. Se sei appassionato di tecnologia, ti piace il lavoro pratico e vuoi vedere come le tue idee creano un reale valore aggiunto, non vediamo l'ora di sentire la tua opinione. Come avrai un impatto Familiarizzare con le applicazioni esistenti basate sulla piattaforma Microsoft Power Supportare l'ulteriore espansione e sviluppo del panorama applicativo nel settore dei servizi Analizzare i processi aziendali e identificare le opportunità di automazione Sviluppare applicazioni low-code in base ai requisiti aziendali Collaborare con sviluppatori e reparti di assistenza Supportare la documentazione di applicazioni e processi Il tuo background Attualmente studi di informatica, informatica aziendale o un argomento simile Esperienza iniziale con la piattaforma Microsoft Power (Power Apps, Power Automate, ecc.) o tecnologie low-code comparabili Comprensione di base di programmazione e digitale applicazioni e un modo di lavorare strutturato Interesse per i processi aziendali operativi, idealmente nel settore dei servizi o industriale Indipendente e giocatore di squadra con una volontà di apprendere e una forte motivazione a svilupparsi ulteriormente Buona padronanza del tedesco e dell'inglese Maggiori informazioni su di noi Siamo un'azienda orientata alla tecnologia con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, supporto dedicato e un ambiente inclusivo e solidale in cui puoi crescere sia a livello personale che professionale. Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura, inclusa una breve lettera di presentazione e una trascrizione degli atti, insieme al tuo CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, tieni presente che è richiesto un certificato universitario ufficiale che confermi che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei tuoi studi.

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zurigo-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolati in gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione stiamo cercando un responsabile funzionale del team di standardizzazione in ingegneria secondaria. In questa posizione impegnativa assumerai la guida funzionale del team di standardizzazione per portare avanti la standardizzazione e i miglioramenti del prodotto. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team di ingegneria secondaria in Svizzera, Germania e India e svilupperai una tabella di marcia per la standardizzazione che guida lo sviluppo del nostro prodotto per il futuro. Insieme al team di standardizzazione, garantirai l'implementazione di successo dei miglioramenti, come il rilascio di nuovi modelli e linee guida ingegneristiche che consentano all'ingegneria di fornire i propri progetti in modo efficace e di alta qualità. Come avrai un impatto Guidare in modo funzionale il team di standardizzazione dell'ingegneria secondaria, compresa la gestione quotidiana delle attività, la pianificazione e il bilanciamento del carico di lavoro del team, garantendo progresso, trasparenza e utilizzo efficace delle capacità del team e lo sviluppo delle competenze richieste al team Definire gli standard di progettazione GIS dell'ingegneria secondaria attraverso lo sviluppo di modelli e linee guida di progettazione con il supporto del team di standardizzazione e degli esperti Sviluppare, mantenere e aggiornare regolarmente la tabella di marcia per la standardizzazione dell'ingegneria secondaria in collaborazione con i membri del team di standardizzazione, le principali parti interessate all'interno dell'ingegneria secondaria e altri dipartimenti Impegnarsi nel processo di qualità e nei cicli di miglioramento continuo dell'organizzazione GIS e collaborare attivamente con altri team di ingegneri e parti interessate per discutere, valutare e allineare i miglioramenti e per dare loro priorità per l'implementazione Eseguire e guidare tecnicamente attività di miglioramento dalla roadmap di standardizzazione individualmente Guidare la standardizzazione e l'armonizzazione dei modelli E3 per fornire una base efficiente e di alta qualità per schemi specifici del progetto Il tuo background Background di ingegneria elettrica Dimostrata capacità di guidare con successo, sia in posizione dirigenziale che in progetti impegnativi e complessi Solida esperienza nell'ingegneria di Attrezzatura secondaria (LCC) come PM di ingegneria secondaria Esperienza degli strumenti corrispondenti utilizzati per l'ingegneria secondaria Disponibilità ad assumere il ruolo di leadership funzionale all'interno di un team. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti, certificazioni, ad es. poiché PMP è un vantaggio. Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Il tedesco o qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio Il titolare del lavoro vive un pensiero innovativo e orientato alle prestazioni, oltre a seguire i valori di Hitachi Energy e fornisce un contributo personale a una buona atmosfera lavorativa Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, ist weltweit als Spezialist für Stromübertragung und -verteilung bekannt. Unsere Einheit Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon ist in der Entwicklung und Produktion von gasisolierten Schaltanlagen tätig. Die hohe Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme stellen wir durch den Einsatz modernster Entwicklungstools und -methoden sicher. Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte suchen wir einen funktionalen Leiter des Standardisierungsteams im Secondary Engineering. In dieser herausfordernden Position übernehmen Sie die funktionale Leitung des Standardisierungsteams, um die Produktstandardisierung und -verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Secondary Engineering-Team in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Indien zusammen und entwickeln eine Standardisierungs-Roadmap, die die Entwicklung unseres Produkts für die Zukunft leitet. Gemeinsam mit dem Standardisierungsteam sorgen Sie für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Verbesserungen, wie z. B. die Veröffentlichung neuer Vorlagen und Engineering-Richtlinien, die es dem Engineering ermöglichen, seine Projekte effektiv und in hoher Qualität abzuwickeln. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Führen Sie das Secondary Engineering Standardisierungsteam funktional, einschließlich der täglichen Verwaltung von
• Aufgaben, Planung und Ausgleich der Teamarbeitsbelastung, stellen Sie Fortschritt, Transparenz und effektive Nutzung der Teamkapazität und Entwicklung der erforderlichen Kompetenzen sicher. Definieren Sie GIS Secondary Engineering Designstandards durch die Entwicklung von Vorlagen und Designrichtlinien mit Unterstützung des Standardisierungsteams und von Experten. Entwickeln, pflegen und aktualisieren Sie regelmäßig die Secondary Engineering Standardisierungs-Roadmap in Zusammenarbeit mit den Mitgliedern des Standardisierungsteams, den wichtigsten Interessenvertretern im Secondary Engineering und anderen Abteilungen. Beteiligen Sie sich den Qualitätsprozess und die kontinuierlichen Verbesserungszyklen der GIS-Organisation und arbeiten aktiv mit anderen Engineering-Teams und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Verbesserungen zu diskutieren, zu bewerten und auszurichten und sie für die Implementierung zu priorisieren. Führen Sie Verbesserungsaufgaben aus der Standardisierungs-Roadmap individuell aus und leiten Sie sie technisch. Treiben Sie die Standardisierung und Harmonisierung von E3-Vorlagen voran, um eine effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Grundlage für projektspezifische Schaltpläne zu bieten. Ihr Hintergrund: Elektrotechnik-Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, erfolgreich zu leiten, entweder in Managementposition oder in anspruchsvollen und komplexen Projekten. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, est reconnu dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse. Nous garantissons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. Pour notre unité commerciale Produits Haute Tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en ingénierie secondaire. Dans ce poste stimulant, vous assumerez la direction fonctionnelle de l'équipe de normalisation afin de faire progresser la normalisation et les améliorations des produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie secondaire en Suisse, en Allemagne et en Inde et développerez une feuille de route de normalisation qui guide le développement de notre produit pour l'avenir. En collaboration avec l'équipe de normalisation, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie des améliorations, telles que la publication de nouveaux modèles et de directives d'ingénierie qui permettent à l'ingénierie de réaliser ses projets de manière efficace et de haute qualité. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger fonctionnellement l'équipe de normalisation de l'ingénierie secondaire, y compris la gestion quotidienne des tâches, la planification et l'équilibrage de la charge de travail de l'équipe, en garantissant les progrès, la transparence et l'utilisation efficace de la capacité de l'équipe et le développement des compétences requises. Définir les normes de conception de l'ingénierie secondaire SIG à travers le développement de modèles et de lignes directrices de conception avec le soutien de l'équipe de normalisation et des experts. Cycles d'amélioration continue de l'organisation SIG et collaborer activement avec d'autres équipes d'ingénierie et parties prenantes pour discuter, évaluer et aligner les améliorations, et les hiérarchiser pour la mise en œuvre. Exécuter et diriger techniquement les tâches d'amélioration de la feuille de route de normalisation individuellement. Piloter la normalisation et l'harmonisation des modèles E3 pour fournir une base efficace et de haute qualité pour les schémas spécifiques au projet. jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Nel nostro centro di profitto a Wettingen produciamo e offriamo soluzioni di protezione contro le sovratensioni innovative, affidabili e sicure per la produzione/distribuzione di energia, nonché per i segmenti ferroviario e industriale. Il nostro obiettivo è supportare i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo con tecnologie di alta qualità e creare valore aggiunto sostenibile. Ciò si ottiene attraverso il continuo sviluppo delle nostre tecnologie chiave e il costante miglioramento dei nostri processi, supportati da una collaborazione aperta e da un forte spirito di squadra. In qualità di leader del team di manutenzione, assumi un ruolo responsabile e guidi un team impegnato di sei dipendenti. Insieme garantite che tutti gli impianti di produzione e i sistemi tecnici funzionino in modo affidabile in un processo di produzione altamente automatizzato. Definisci attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo della manutenzione, sia dal punto di vista strategico che operativo, e lavori a stretto contatto e in collaborazione con il management e altre aree. L’obiettivo è garantire un’elevata disponibilità del sistema, sicurezza e un’organizzazione efficiente e sostenibile. Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Insieme al tuo team, l'organizzazione della manutenzione viene ulteriormente sviluppata e rafforzata Pianificazione, coordinamento e implementazione delle misure di manutenzione e riparazione (preventive, correttive e olistiche) sono la tua area di responsabilità Le strategie sostenibili per migliorare la disponibilità, la produttività e la durata di servizio dei sistemi sono avviate e guidate da te Lo sviluppo professionale e personale del tuo team è attivamente supportato e promosso La responsabilità della pianificazione del budget e un uso consapevole e sostenibile delle risorse (inclusi i pezzi di ricambio e la strategia di stoccaggio) fanno parte del tuo ruolo Nella conversione, lavorerai a stretto contatto con vari dipartimenti su nuove costruzioni e progetti di investimento. Garantirai il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza, ambientali e di qualità. I processi verranno continuamente migliorati e integrati da soluzioni moderne e digitali e da sistemi di indicatori chiave di prestazione. Cosa porti con te Titolo di studio tecnico conseguito (es. ingegneria, meccatronica, ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia dell'automazione) o una qualifica comparabile costituisce la tua base. descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Dans notre centre de profit de Wettingen, nous produisons et proposons des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production/distribution d'électricité ainsi que des secteurs ferroviaire et industriel. Notre objectif est de soutenir nos clients dans le monde entier avec des technologies de haute qualité et de créer une valeur ajoutée durable. Ceci est réalisé grâce au développement continu de nos technologies de base et à l’amélioration constante de nos processus – soutenus par une collaboration ouverte et un fort esprit d’équipe. En tant que chef d'équipe de maintenance, vous assumez un rôle responsable et dirigez une équipe engagée de six employés. Ensemble, vous veillez à ce que toutes les installations de production et tous les systèmes techniques fonctionnent de manière fiable dans le cadre d'une production hautement automatisée. Vous façonnez activement le développement futur de la maintenance - tant sur le plan stratégique qu'opérationnel - et travaillez en étroite collaboration et en partenariat avec la direction et d'autres domaines. L’objectif est de garantir une disponibilité élevée du système, la sécurité et une organisation efficace et durable. C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser En collaboration avec votre équipe, l'organisation de maintenance est développée et renforcée. La planification, la coordination et la mise en œuvre des mesures de maintenance et de réparation (préventives, correctives et holistiques) relèvent de votre responsabilité. Des stratégies durables visant à améliorer la disponibilité, la productivité et la durée de vie des systèmes sont initiées et pilotées par vous. Le développement professionnel et personnel de votre équipe est activement soutenu et encouragé. La responsabilité de la planification budgétaire ainsi que d'une utilisation consciente et durable des ressources (y compris les pièces de rechange et la stratégie de stockage) font partie de votre rôle. Lors de la conversion, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec divers départements sur les nouveaux projets de construction et d'investissement. Vous veillerez au respect des normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité. Les processus seront continuellement améliorés et complétés par des solutions numériques modernes et des systèmes d'indicateurs de performance clés. Ce que vous apportez avec vous Un diplôme technique complété (par ex. Ingénierie, mécatronique, électrotechnique, technologie d'automatisation) ou une qualification comparable constitue votre base. Vous possédez plusieurs années d'expérience en maintenance et idéalement dans un rôle managérial au sein d'une production automatisée. Vous avez des connaissances en automatisation, robots et systèmes de contrôle. Une expérience des approches de maintenance structurées et d’amélioration continue complète votre profil. Vous aimez travailler avec différents domaines spécialisés. Une façon de travailler structurée et orientée vers les solutions combinée à une capacité d'accompagnement et de développement des personnes est ce qui vous différencie. Une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise. En savoir plus sur nous Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à bien combiner travail et vie privée. Un environnement valorisant est important pour nous afin que vous puissiez vous impliquer, vous développer davantage et libérer votre potentiel. --- Traduction en anglais ci-dessous --- Chef d'équipe Maintenance 80–100 % (f\/m\/d) L'opportunité Dans notre centre de profit de parasurtenseurs à Wettingen, vous travaillerez avec nous pour développer, fabriquer et fournir des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production et de la distribution d'électricité, des chemins de fer et de l'industrie. Notre ambition est de soutenir nos clients du monde entier avec des technologies de haute qualité et de créer une valeur ajoutée durable. Ceci est réalisé grâce à l’avancement continu de nos technologies de base et à l’amélioration continue de nos processus, motivés par une collaboration ouverte et un fort esprit d’équipe. topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation.  Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders.  Your background  Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un Service Sales Engineer per la nostra Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, a Ginevra (Svizzera). Segnalando al Servizio di Trazione Vendite e Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita nell'area assegnata. Sarete parte del team di vendita che si concentra sul servizio Traction Transformer in Europa. In qualità di Service Sales Engineer è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e di servizi ferroviari per l'attrezzatura del materiale rotabile. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se sei un ingegnere altamente qualificato e motivato che cerca di unirsi a un team dinamico, ti invitiamo a applicare. Sostenere il team di vendita e i clienti durante tutto il processo di vendita, sviluppando al contempo nuovi e esistenti business, aumentando la conoscenza interna ed esterna dei prodotti e del mercato Preparazione dell'offerta tecnica in conformità con il portafoglio unità e la necessità del cliente. Rivendicare gli aspetti tecnici e commerciali dell'offerta Partecipando alle discussioni sulla strategia di vendita, assegnando obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine e negoziando i vari budget di vendita del Gruppo di prodotti e piani di marketing Identificare le esigenze dei clienti e le offerte dei concorrenti attraverso l'analisi del mercato, assicurando un'efficace azione di marketing e comunicazione dimostra la proposizione di valore dei prodotti, sistemi, servizi e pacchetti La tua laurea di primo livello in ingegneria e più di 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite dirette e delle vendite La conoscenza del mercato delle ferrovie e dei clienti ferroviari (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing) è un vantaggio Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione del conto e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi Comprensione di preparazione dell'offerta, negoziazione del contratto, gestione del rischio e termini commerciali e legali Viaggiare principalmente all'interno dell'Unione Europea se necessario. I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager Sie werden die Verkaufsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses in dem zugewiesenen Bereich unterstützen. Sie werden Teil des Verkaufsteams sein, das sich auf Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, die nachhaltige Mobilitätswende durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienendienstleistungsportfolio für Fahrzeuge zu ermöglichen. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kollegen zusammen, die über langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der On-Board-Traktionstransformatoren-Services für Fahrzeuge verfügen. Mit Sitz in Genf übernimmt die Rolle Verantwortung für die Bahnkunden in Europa (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften). Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie Einfluss darauf haben, das Verkaufsteam und die Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig neue und bestehende Geschäfte zu entwickeln, indem Sie das interne und externe Wissen über Produkte und den Markt erweitern. Klären der technischen und kommerziellen Aspekte des Angebots Teilnahme an Verkaufsstrategie Diskussionen, Zuweisung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele und Verhandlungen der verschiedenen Produktgruppe Verkaufsbudgets und Marketingpläne Identifizierung der Kundenbedürfnisse und Angebote der Wettbewerber durch Marktanalyse, Gewährleistung effizienter Marketingaktionen und Kommunikationen zeigen das Wertversprechen der Produkte, Systeme, Service und Pakete Unterstützung des Bereichs Verkaufsorganisation / Kunden bei der Bestimmung der technisch angemessensten und kosteneffektivsten Lösungen und Bereitstellung von technischem Support, Produktpräsentationen und Produkt / Lösung / Service-bezogenes Training Übernahme der Verantwortung für spezifische Kundenfälle, um eine effiziente Lösung von Kundenproblemen zu gewährleisten und die zukünftige Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen Durchführung von Verkaufsleistungsüberprüfungen, Vorschlag von Wiederherstellungsplänen in Fällen von möglichen Auftragslücken und Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Verkaufsaktivitäten Berichte zur Unterstützung bei der Produktionsplanung Leben Kernwerte der Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Handlungen zu übernehmen, während Sie sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse des Schienenfahrzeugmarktes und der Schienenkunden (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften) sind ein Vorteil, der sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich fließend Französisch und Englisch spricht. Andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Kontoverwaltung und Cross-Selling über Systeme, Lösungen, Produkte und Dienstleistungskategorien Verständnis der Angebotsvorbereitung, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement und kommerzielle und rechtliche Begriffe Reisen vor allem innerhalb der Europäischen Union, wenn nötig. Häufige Interaktion mit Bahnkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre service de transformation de traction, à Genève (Suisse). Sous l'autorité du directeur des ventes et du marketing du service de traction, vous soutiendrez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone attribuée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de vente qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que Service Sales Engineer, c'est votre tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires et de services ferroviaires de pointe pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les différents budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, systèmes, services et forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit/solution\/service S'approprier des cas particuliers des clients pour assurer une résolution efficace des problèmes des clients et analyser la cause fondamentale de toute proposition perdue, accroître la compétitivité future Effectuer des examens du rendement des ventes, proposer des plans de récupération en cas de manque potentiel de commandes et fournir des rapports réguliers d'activités de vente pour aider à la planification de la production Vivre des valeurs fondamentales de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie assumer la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients ferroviaires (fabricants de trains OEM, exploitants ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience en développement d'entreprise, gestion de compte et vente croisée entre systèmes, solutions, produits et catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation de l'offre, négociation de contrat, gestion des risques et conditions commerciales et juridiques Voyage principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire. Une interaction fréquente avec les clients du rail et l'équipe HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales sont attendues Plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les collaborateurs peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant qu'expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de rechercher, d’analyser et d’interpréter les menaces de sécurité émergentes qui pourraient avoir un impact sur les employés, les actifs ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Relevant du chef de la sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions commerciales critiques grâce à des informations d'experts en matière de sécurité. Comment vous aurez un impact Analysez les menaces émergentes à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournissez des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/cluster, en garantissant l'alignement avec les normes de sécurité régionales et les KPI. Assurer la conformité par le biais d’audits, d’inspections et de surveillance de l’évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. Fournir des conseils d’experts en matière de gestion des risques de sécurité pour soutenir les décisions commerciales clés. Favoriser l’amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. Engager les parties prenantes internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation et les performances en matière de sécurité. Diriger ou soutenir des projets liés à la sécurité, en gérant les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d’urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau national. Votre parcours Min. 5 ans de formation supérieure et expérience significative en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. Expertise avérée en matière de renseignement sur les menaces, d’analyse des risques et de gestion de crise. Solide compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus d'audit. Expérience d'encadrement et de conseil aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. Affaires parlant couramment l'allemand et l'anglais. jobs.title: Project Management Engineering e-Mobility 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our dynamic Engineering team in Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, as a Project Manager Engineering and lead technically the execution and tendering of cutting-edge eMobility electric power supply infrastructure projects—including DC charging solutions for electric buses. You'll shape technical solutions, lead engineering efforts across MV & LV distribution systems and power conversion equipment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about sustainable mobility and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Take technical lead in execution and tendering of eMobility electrical infrastructure projects (e.g., bus depots, terminal charging stations), support and guide Local execution and tendering teams Own all engineering activities across project lifecycles—from concept to commissioning Collaborate internally with Local Operating Units responsible for project execution and tendering, Sales, R&D, Product engineers, Supply chain, Site Installation & Commissioning teams and externally with customers, suppliers Coordinate and supervise remote engineering teams for primary and secondary engineering tasks as applicable Design power supply system architectures, perform sizing calculations, and prepare technical specifications Evaluate supplier offers and support procurement processes with Supply Chain Management Provide technical expertise during tendering and project execution phases Translate customer requirements into optimized, compliant technical solutions Lead technical discussions with clients, resolve site queries, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables Ensure safety, compliance, and engineering excellence throughout the project Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on Power Electronics or Power Systems 7–10 years of experience in MV\/LV power distribution systems, electrical systems design & engineering Experience with DC power supply systems, power converters, energy storage, or harmonic filtering is a plus Strong knowledge of engineering tools and software (e.g., BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) Proactive, results-driven mindset with strong teamwork and communication skills Committed to safety, quality, and continuous learning Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer and project meetings Fluent in English and French More about us

Die Gelegenheit: Werden Sie Teil unseres dynamischen Engineering-Teams im Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, als Projektmanager Engineering und leiten Sie technisch die Ausführung und Ausschreibung hochmoderner Infrastrukturprojekte für die Stromversorgung im Bereich E-Mobilität – einschließlich Gleichstrom-Ladelösungen für Elektrobusse. Sie gestalten technische Lösungen, leiten technische Anstrengungen für MS- und NS-Verteilungssysteme sowie Stromumwandlungsgeräte und arbeiten mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Innovation und Exzellenz voranzutreiben. Wenn Sie sich für nachhaltige Mobilität begeistern und in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umfeld erfolgreich sind, ist dies Ihre Chance, etwas zu bewirken. Within Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Product Group, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our global Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) business, based in Zürich-Oerlikon, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of strategically important projects in a global, matrix organization. You will lead cross-functional teams across regions, act as a key interface to international customers, and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Sind Sie bestrebt, durch die Leitung komplexer, hochwertiger Projekte globale Wirkung zu erzielen? Kombinieren Sie strategisches Denken mit starken Umsetzungsfähigkeiten? Innerhalb der Hochspannungsproduktgruppe von Hitachi Energy gestalten wir die Zukunft der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. In unserem globalen Geschäft für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon liefern wir fortschrittliche Lösungen mit den höchsten Standards an Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Projektmanager, der strategisch wichtige Projekte in einer globalen Matrixorganisation übernimmt. Sie leiten funktionsübergreifende Teams über Regionen hinweg, fungieren als wichtige Schnittstelle zu internationalen Kunden, treiben die erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung voran und tragen gleichzeitig zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und langfristigen Wertschöpfung bei. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Führen Sie die End-to-End-Ausführung komplexer, internationaler Projekte von der kommerziellen Übergabe bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ziele in Bezug auf Umfang, Zeitrahmen, Qualität und Finanzen erfüllt werden. Fungieren Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zu globalen Kunden, bauen Sie vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und leiten Sie wirkungsvolle Projekte, einschließlich technischer Gespräche und Werksabnahmetests. Fördern Sie ein proaktives Risiko- und Chancenmanagement und wenden Sie eine strategische Denkweise an, um nachhaltige Projektergebnisse sicherzustellen. Behalten Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Projektleistung, einschließlich Finanzsteuerung, Ressourcenplanung und Prognosen in enger Abstimmung mit der Steuerung. Leiten Sie den Vertrag Ausführung, einschließlich Änderungs- und Anspruchsmanagement, unter Wahrung der Kundenzufriedenheit und der Geschäftsinteressen. Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung zwischen den Entwicklungs-, Fertigungs- und Lieferkettenteams in einem globalen Umfeld. Tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen bei und gestalten Sie aktiv Best Practices innerhalb der Projektmanagementfunktion. Ihr Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz (7+ Jahre) bei der Leitung komplexer Projekte in einem industriellen oder technologieorientierten Umfeld, idealerweise mit internationaler Präsenz. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf mehreren Ebenen zu führen, einschließlich leitender Kundenvertreter und interner Führung. Starkes kaufmännisches Verständnis mit solider Expertise in Finanzsteuerung, Risikomanagement und Vertragsabwicklung Sicherer Kommunikator mit der Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Kontext Einfluss zu nehmen, zu verhandeln und effektiv zu präsentieren Erfahrung in der Arbeit in Matrixorganisationen und der Führung interkultureller Teams Relevante Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen (z. B. PMP, IPMA) sind von Vorteil. Fließende Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse; Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind obligatorisch. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous déterminé à créer un impact mondial grâce à la direction de projets complexes et de grande valeur ? Combinez-vous réflexion stratégique et fortes capacités d’exécution ? Au sein du groupe de produits haute tension d'Hitachi Energy, nous façonnons l'avenir du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. Dans notre activité mondiale d'appareillage à isolation gazeuse (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, nous proposons des solutions avancées répondant aux normes les plus élevées de fiabilité et d'innovation. Nous recherchons un chef de projet expérimenté pour prendre en charge des projets stratégiquement importants dans une organisation matricielle mondiale. Vous dirigerez des équipes interfonctionnelles dans toutes les régions, agirez en tant qu'interface clé avec les clients internationaux et piloterez la réussite des projets tout en contribuant à l'amélioration continue et à la création de valeur à long terme. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout de projets internationaux complexes, depuis le transfert commercial jusqu'à la clôture réussie, en garantissant la livraison dans le respect des objectifs de portée, de calendrier, de qualité et financiers. Agir en tant qu'interface principale avec les clients mondiaux, en établissant des relations de confiance et en dirigeant des engagements à fort impact, y compris des discussions techniques et des tests d'acceptation en usine. Piloter une gestion proactive des risques et des opportunités, en appliquant un état d'esprit stratégique pour garantir des résultats de projet durables. Maintenir l'entière responsabilité de la performance du projet, y compris la direction financière, la planification des ressources et les prévisions en étroite adéquation avec le contrôle. sauvegarder à la fois la satisfaction des clients et les intérêts commerciaux Favoriser la collaboration et l'alignement interfonctionnels entre les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de chaîne d'approvisionnement dans une configuration mondiale Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue et façonner activement les meilleures pratiques au sein de la fonction de gestion de projet Votre expérience Expérience avérée (7 ans et plus) dans la gestion de projets complexes dans un environnement industriel ou technologique, idéalement avec une exposition internationale Capacité démontrée à diriger des parties prenantes à plusieurs niveaux, y compris des représentants seniors des clients et la direction interne Fort sens commercial avec une solide expertise en pilotage financier, en gestion des risques et en exécution de contrats Communicateur confiant avec la capacité de influencer, négocier et présenter efficacement dans un contexte international Expérience de travail dans des organisations matricielles et de direction d'équipes interculturelles Certifications pertinentes en gestion de projet (par exemple, PMP, IPMA) sont un avantage Maîtrise de l'allemand ou du français ; affaires, la maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer high Voltage and Production Developer 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Industrial Engineering team, where team members work within two clearly differentiated focus areas: production development and industrial engineering. Each role has a defined main focus in one of these domains, while both profiles collaborate closely within the same team and contribute to shared production goals. Depending on your background, you will take ownership of one focus area while staying connected to the broader engineering activities. You will work hands‑on with production, engineering, and suppliers in a highly collaborative environment. This setup allows you to deepen your expertise while understanding adjacent processes. You will grow through real shopfloor impact, responsibility, and cross‑functional collaboration. How you'll make an impact Develop and optimize production equipment and processes Design mechanical components tools and technical solutions Support industrialization of new products and manufacturing concepts Improve efficiency quality and cost across production Develop and optimize high voltage production processes Analyze and solve electrical and technical production issues Ensure safe and compliant manufacturing concepts Collaborate with engineering quality and suppliers Your background Degree in mechanical or electrical engineering or similar field Solid understanding of mechanical or electrical systems Experience with technical drawings schematics or CAD tools Structured independent and solution‑oriented working style Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills Good communication skills in a technical environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e gioca un ruolo chiave nella guida di una forte salute, sicurezza e cultura ambientale nelle nostre operazioni di fabbrica a Zurigo. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i team di leadership e interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, minimizzare i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE, supportando operazioni sostenibili e sicure. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative HSE, delle politiche interne e degli standard di Hitachi Energy attraverso le valutazioni dei rischi, degli audit e delle ispezioni per identificare i rischi e definire le azioni di mitigazione

descriptionByLocale.de: The Opportunity begleiten Hitachi Energy als HSE-Profi und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung einer starken Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur in unserem Werk in Zürich. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Compliance sicherzustellen, Risiken zu minimieren und die HSE-Leistung kontinuierlich zu verbessern und gleichzeitig einen nachhaltigen und sicheren Betrieb zu unterstützen.
