B. Abfall, Wasser, Energie) Ihr Hintergrund Mindestens 5 Jahre HSE-Erfahrung in einem Industrie- oder Energieumfeld Führen Sie HSE-Initiativen und Umweltverbesserungsprogramme (z. B. Abfall, Wasser, Energie) Führen Sie HSE-Erfahrung in einem Industrie- oder Energieumfeld Führen Sie HSE-Erfahrung in einem Industrie- oder Energieumfeld Abschluss in Industrie, Umweltwissenschaften, Arbeitsschutz und HSE Swiss Vorschriften Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Risikobewertungen, Vorfallanalyse und Leistungsberichterstattung
descriptionByLocale.fr: The Opportunity Rejoignez Hitachi Energy en tant que professionnel HSE et jouez un rôle clé dans la promotion d'une culture de la santé, de la sécurité et de l'environnement au sein de nos usines de Zurich. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de leadership et des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'assurer la conformité, de minimiser les risques et d'améliorer continuellement le rendement en matière de SSE tout en soutenant des opérations durables et sécuritaires. Faire des évaluations des risques, des audits et des inspections afin d'identifier les risques et de définir des mesures d'atténuation Conduire des enquêtes sur les incidents et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces Surveiller les IRC HSE, préparer des rapports et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données Offrir et coordonner des séances de formation sur les ITS tout en favorisant la sensibilisation et les meilleures pratiques Soutenir les audits internes, externes et de certification, en veillant à ce que des mesures de suivi opportunes Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants externes pour intégrer les ISP aux opérations quotidiennes Diriger les initiatives HSE et les programmes d'amélioration de l'environnement (p. ex. déchets, eau, énergie) Votre contexte Expérience minimum de 5 ans d'expérience HSE dans un environnement industriel ou énergétique Degré d'ingénierie, de sciences de l'environnement, d'hygiène et de sécurité au travail, ou domaine similaire Certifiés professionnels HSE selon la législation suisse (obligatoire) Fortes connaissances des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001 et de la réglementation suisse HSE Expérience éprouvée en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'analyse d'incidents et d'information sur les performances

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Ti piacerebbe realizzare progetti entusiasmanti nel campo dei trasformatori in un team internazionale? Hai esperienza nella gestione di progetti orientata al cliente e ottimizzata in termini di costi e vorresti contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronti a contribuire a plasmare il futuro – idealmente nel sud della Germania? Allora candidati adesso! Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Responsabilità per progetti medio-grandi nel settore dei trasformatori Controllo e monitoraggio dei requisiti del progetto, inclusi programmi, documentazione, ottimizzazioni del progetto, controllo dei costi, obiettivi del progetto e valutazione dei rischi Chiarimento dei dettagli tecnici con i clienti e le parti interessate interne dopo aver ricevuto un ordine Persona di contatto centrale per la comunicazione interna ed esterna del progetto, sia ai clienti che al sito di produzione Garantire il completamento del progetto con successo in conformità con le condizioni contrattuali e le linee guida interne Responsabilità per la gestione dei reclami e dei reclami per ridurre al minimo i potenziali rischi aziendali Il tuo background Studi di ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica o in un settore comparabile Almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi, possibilmente con diversi progetti paralleli Buona conoscenza dei trasformatori, conoscenza della tecnologia dell'alta tensione è un vantaggio Esperienza nella gestione dei sinistri e dei rischi Buona conoscenza del diritto contrattuale Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, il francese è un vantaggio Certificazione di gestione del progetto (ad es. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) è un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere. --- Traduzione in inglese di seguito --- Project Manager commerciale - Trasformatori 80 - 100% (f\/m\/d) L'opportunità Ti piacerebbe realizzare entusiasmanti progetti di trasformatori come parte di un team internazionale? Porti esperienza nella gestione di progetti incentrati sul cliente e ottimizzati in termini di costi e vuoi contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronto a contribuire a plasmare il futuro? Allora candidati adesso! Come avrai un impatto Responsabilità per progetti di medie e grandi dimensioni nel settore dei trasformatori Gestione e monitoraggio dei requisiti del progetto, inclusi programmi, documentazione, ottimizzazioni del progetto, controllo dei costi, obiettivi del progetto e valutazioni dei rischi Chiarimento dei dettagli tecnici con i clienti e le parti interessate interne dopo l'effettuazione dell'ordine Agire come punto di contatto centrale per la comunicazione interna ed esterna del progetto, sia con i clienti che con il sito di produzione Garantire il completamento del progetto con successo in conformità con le condizioni contrattuali e le linee guida interne Gestione dei reclami e dei reclami per prevenire potenziali rischi aziendali Il tuo background Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Meccanica, o in un campo comparabile Almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti, idealmente coinvolgendo più progetti paralleli Conoscenza approfondita dei trasformatori, conoscenza della tecnologia dell'alta tensione è un vantaggio Esperienza nella gestione dei sinistri e dei rischi Solida conoscenza del diritto contrattuale Ottima conoscenza di tedesco e inglese, il francese è un vantaggio Certificazione di gestione del progetto (ad es. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) è un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Vous souhaitez réaliser des projets passionnants dans le domaine des transformateurs au sein d'une équipe internationale ? Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de projets orientée client et optimisée en termes de coûts et souhaitez-vous contribuer activement au développement ultérieur d'un environnement dynamique ? Prêt à contribuer à façonner l’avenir – idéalement dans le sud de l’Allemagne ? Alors postulez maintenant ! C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser Responsabilité de projets de moyenne à grande envergure dans le secteur des transformateurs Contrôle et surveillance des exigences du projet, y compris les calendriers, la documentation, les optimisations du projet, le contrôle des coûts, les objectifs du projet et les évaluations des risques Clarification des détails techniques avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes après réception d'une commande Personne de contact centrale pour la communication interne et externe du projet, tant avec les clients que le site de production Assurer la réussite du projet conformément aux conditions contractuelles et aux directives internes Responsabilité de la gestion des réclamations et des plaintes afin de minimiser les risques commerciaux potentiels. domaine comparable Au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets complexes, idéalement avec plusieurs projets parallèles Bonne connaissance des transformateurs, la connaissance de la technologie haute tension est un avantage Expérience en gestion des sinistres et des risques Bonne connaissance du droit des contrats Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, le français est un avantage Certification en gestion de projet (par ex. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) est un plus. En savoir plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer. --- Traduction en anglais ci-dessous --- Chef de projet commercial – Transformateurs 80 – 100 % (f\/m\/d) L'opportunité Souhaitez-vous réaliser des projets de transformateurs passionnants au sein d'une équipe internationale ? Vous apportez une expérience dans la gestion de projets orientée client et à coûts optimisés et souhaitez contribuer activement au développement d'un environnement dynamique ? Prêt à contribuer à façonner l’avenir ? Alors postulez maintenant ! Comment vous aurez un impact Responsabilité des projets de moyenne à grande envergure dans le secteur des transformateurs Gestion et suivi des exigences du projet, y compris les calendriers, la documentation, les optimisations du projet, le contrôle des coûts, les objectifs du projet et les évaluations des risques Clarification des détails techniques avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes après la passation de commande Agir en tant que point de contact central pour la communication interne et externe du projet, à la fois avec les clients et le site de production Assurer la réussite du projet conformément aux conditions contractuelles et aux directives internes Propriété des réclamations et de la gestion des plaintes pour prévenir les risques commerciaux potentiels Votre formation Diplôme en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou un domaine comparable Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, impliquant idéalement plusieurs projets parallèles Connaissance approfondie des transformateurs, des connaissances en technologie Haute Tension sont un plus Expérience en gestion des sinistres et des risques Solide compréhension du droit des contrats Maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais, le français est un plus Certification en gestion de projet (par ex. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position As the world's leading supplier of power semiconductors, Hitachi Energy offers one of the most diverse product portfolios. Including; Thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors (GTOs), integrated gate-commutated thyristors (IGCTs), insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) and MOSFETs - which are valued for their high quality and reliability in industry, power transmission and distribution, mobility and renewable energy. We are looking for a temporary automation technician for our team who will be involved in setting up and commissioning our power semiconductor test systems. This is what you can do Setting up power semiconductor test systems including mechanics, electrics, pneumatics and hydraulics Carrying out adjustment work on faulty designs, production parts or schemes Checking all mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, programmed and hydraulic functions Carrying out grounding measurements (checking the continuity of the protective conductor system according to EN 60204-1 18b) Creating commissioning and insulation coordination protocols Carrying out commissioning and isolation coordination of test systems Ensuring compliance with quality, safety and standard requirements Active participation in the optimization of processes and systems What you bring with you Completed training as an automation engineer EFZ (possibly. with a higher technical college), ideally with professional experience in assembly Experience in project management Sound know-how in the mechanical processing of materials (turning, milling, drilling, sawing, etc.) Familiarity with power semiconductors, measurement technology as well as relevant guidelines and standards Confident use of Office 365 Very good written and spoken German and good English skills More about us Temporary position in a leading international high-tech company Varied and responsible
• tasks in the field of power semiconductors Open Corporate culture with short decision-making processes, attractive social benefits and modern work equipment

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste En tant que premier fournisseur mondial de semi-conducteurs de puissance, Hitachi Energy propose l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés. Y compris; Thyristors, diodes, thyristors à commutation de grille (GTO), thyristors à commutation de grille intégrée (IGCT), transistors bipolaires à grille isolée (IGBT) et MOSFET - qui sont appréciés pour leur haute qualité et leur fiabilité dans l'industrie, le transport et la distribution d'énergie, la mobilité et les énergies renouvelables. Nous recherchons pour notre équipe un technicien en automation temporaire qui sera impliqué dans la mise en place et la mise en service de nos systèmes de tests de semi-conducteurs de puissance. C'est ce que vous pouvez faire Mettre en place des systèmes de test de semi-conducteurs de puissance, y compris mécaniques, électriques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques Effectuer des travaux de réglage sur des conceptions, des pièces ou des schémas de production défectueux Vérifier toutes les fonctions mécaniques, pneumatiques, électriques, programmées et hydrauliques Effectuer des mesures de mise à la terre (vérifier la continuité du système de conducteurs de protection selon EN 60204-1 18b) Créer des protocoles de mise en service et de coordination d'isolation Effectuer la coordination de mise en service et d'isolement des systèmes de test Assurer le respect des exigences de qualité, de sécurité et des normes Participation active à l'optimisation des processus et des systèmes Ce que vous apportez Une formation complétée en tant qu'ingénieur en automatisation EFZ (éventuellement. avec une école technique supérieure), idéalement avec une expérience professionnelle dans le montage Expérience en gestion de projet Solide savoir-faire dans le traitement mécanique des matériaux (tournage, fraisage, perçage, sciage, etc.) Familiarité avec les semi-conducteurs de puissance, la technologie de mesure ainsi que les directives et normes pertinentes Utilisation sûre d'Office 365 Très bonnes compétences en allemand écrit et oral et bonne anglais En savoir plus sur nous Poste temporaire dans une entreprise internationale de haute technologie de premier plan Tâches variées et responsables dans le domaine des semi-conducteurs de puissance Ouvert Culture d'entreprise avec des processus de décision courts, attrayant avantages sociaux et équipements de travail modernes

jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes.  This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Product Engineer – Power Semiconductors Module Packaging (BiMOS) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In qualità di Product Engineer, sarai un membro fondamentale del team di ingegneria del prodotto BiMOS, giocando un ruolo chiave nell'interfaccia di produzione, R&D e qualità. Con sede a Lenzburg, Svizzera, si prende la proprietà end-to-end di una piattaforma di prodotto e la sua ottimizzazione utilizzando l'analisi avanzata dei dati e metodi di miglioramento continuo. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente la qualità del prodotto, la resa e la competitività dei costi nella produzione di semiconduttori ad alta potenza. Come farete un impatto Monitorare, analizzare e interpretare i dati di resa e di qualità per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e promuovere miglioramenti sostenibili nel costo, nella qualità e nel rendimento Prendere la piena proprietà del prodotto dopo R&D handover, tra cui il coordinamento e il monitoraggio di una nuova rampa di prodotto nella linea di fabbricazione Eseguire l'analisi della causa e la risoluzione dei problemi di difetti del prodotto, debolezza e problemi di qualità, derivanti chiare conclusioni sui processi e lacune di progettazione Mantenere, migliorare e implementare l'acquisizione dei dati, analisi e metodi di report per supportare il processo decisionale guidato dai dati e ingegneri R&w con una forte competenza tecnica e metodi di problem-solving Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity To strengthen our front-end sales organization, we are looking for a Head of Bid & Proposal to take on a central role in the Swiss sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for bid management and the creation of high-quality and competitive offers for our portfolio of high-voltage products and transformers. You will further develop the Bid & Proposal team and lead it both professionally and disciplinarily. As a central interface, you coordinate all relevant internal stakeholders and make a significant contribution to the successful development of the Swiss market with timely, high-quality offers. We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record of achieving goals and building high-performing teams in a dynamic growth environment. This is what you can achieve Professional and disciplinary leadership of the bid & proposal and order handling team with a clear focus on growth and business results in line with the Hitachi Energy strategy Further development of competencies, structures and processes to ensure a high-performance, motivated and committed team Overall responsibility for offer processes and order processing in the product business for the Swiss market - on time, quality and in line with the customer Ensuring the correct and on-time delivery and compliant submission of offers in accordance with customer, contractual and internal
• requirements Development and control of offer strategies in close collaboration with Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal as well as the plants Active design of efficient interfaces between sales, engineering and production as well as continuous improvement of offer management processes Living the Hitachi Energy values, in particular safety and integrity Your background Completed studies (Bachelor/Master) in the technical or engineering field; Additional business qualifications are an advantage At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in technical sales, bid & proposal or project management Proven experience in leading or coordinating teams as well as in managing complex stakeholder structures Industry knowledge in the energy sector and strong customer orientation Deep understanding of tendering and order processing processes, incl. SAP basics, commercial processes, contract negotiations, risk and claims management Very good communication skills, independent and proactive way of working, team player Business fluent German and very good spoken and written English; French or Italian is an advantage More about us Varied and responsible work in a dynamic, committed and collaborative environment Clear support for your professional and personal development through structured learning and development offers A corporate culture that values collaboration, diversity and different perspectives A unique culture: Bring in your personality, your passion and your ideas and shape a sustainable energy future with us Flexible working models including hybrid and remote options Attractive, competitive Compensation and benefits package

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

In qualità di Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, si svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità, l'affidabilità e il miglioramento continuo del nostro parco utensili semiconduttore. L'attenzione è rivolta alla corretta, preventiva e predittiva manutenzione delle apparecchiature implantari, lavorando trasversalmente per guidare la sicurezza, la produttività e le ottimizzazioni generali degli utensili e dei flussi di lavoro attraverso la linea di produzione. Miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni dell'attrezzatura, applicazione delle pratiche di sicurezza e di efficienza del posto di lavoro allineate con la metodologia 6S Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri team di manutenzione, processo e produzione per raggiungere gli obiettivi di performance e ottimizzare l'efficienza della linea Partecipare agli aggiornamenti degli strumenti e ai progetti di modernizzazione per migliorare la capacità degli strumenti e l'affidabilità Mantenere la conformità accurata e dettagliata delle attività di manutenzione, La vostra esperienza di sottofondo Hands-on nella manutenzione di strumenti di produzione semiconduttore Solida comprensione di elettronica, meccanica e pneumatica Minimo 3 anni di esperienza con gli impianti ioni (come AMAT o Nissin o Axcelis) Familiarità con strumenti di metrologia per il controllo di processo (Semilab WT-2000) Formazione aggiuntiva o competenza in sistemi di vuoto o tecnologie connesse Formazione professionale tecnica completa (ad esempio, Tecnologia di automazione, Tecnologia elettronica, o campo simile) La volontà di lavorare in turni è un giocatore di squadra forte con la mentalità problem-solving, le abilità organizzative e la competenza in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Hitachi Energy ti offre compiti interessanti in un team altamente motivato e in uno stile di comunicazione aperto. jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion/Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

Favoriser l'amélioration continue de la performance de l'équipement, l'application de pratiques de sécurité et d'efficacité en milieu de travail conformes à la méthodologie 6S Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres équipes de maintenance, de traitement et de production pour atteindre les objectifs de performance et optimiser l'efficacité de la ligne Participer à des projets de modernisation et de modernisation des outils pour améliorer la capacité et la fiabilité des outils Maintenir une documentation précise et détaillée des activités de maintenance, de l'état de l'équipement et des performances du système Soutenir l'analyse des causes profondes et la résolution des problèmes pour les questions techniques au sein de l'équipe Former et encadrer des collègues dans les domaines de la diffusion et de l'implantation, de la sécurité et des meilleures pratiques d'entretien Promouvoir une culture de sécurité solide en assurant le respect de toutes les réglementations, procédures et documents pertinents Votre arrière-plan Expérience pratique dans l'entretien des outils de production de semi-conducteurs Connaissance solide de l'électronique, de la mécanique et des pneumatiques Expérience des systèmes de diffusion (p. ex. ASM, fours à centrothermes) ainsi que des implants ioniques (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarité avec les outils de métrologie pour le contrôle des processus (p. ex. Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Formation ou expertise supplémentaire en systèmes de vide ou technologies connexes Formation professionnelle technique complète (p. ex. technicien en automatisation, technicien en électronique ou domaine similaire) Volonté de travailler en équipe est un must Fort joueur d'équipe avec la mentalité de résolution de problèmes, les compétences organisationnelles, et la compétence en anglais (l'allemand est un plus) En savoir plus sur nous Hitachi Energy vous propose des tâches intéressantes dans une équipe très motivée et un style de communication ouvert. Grâce à un plan d'initiation axé sur l'individu et la pratique, nous vous aiderons à acquérir rapidement la confiance professionnelle pour être en mesure de travailler de façon indépendante avec un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle.

jobs.title: Strategic Buyer – Direct Materials 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We're looking for an experienced Strategic Buyer – Direct Materials to strengthen our global procurement team. You'll manage a largely European supply market, with selective sourcing from Asia and world-wide, and play a critical role in ensuring production availability, our top priority. This role is ideal for a proactive, commercially minded sourcing professional who thrives in a complex, international environment and enjoys driving supplier performance, cost optimization, and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Develop and implement strategic sourcing plans to meet business objectives Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, and manage supplier relationships Conduct market research and analysis to stay informed of industry trends and best practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of procurement strategies with overall business goals Monitor and manage supplier performance, ensuring compliance with quality standards and delivery timelines, and continuous supplier development Drive cost reduction initiatives and identify opportunities for process improvements Negotiate contracts and coordinate supplier integration plans with internal clients Monitor market dynamics that impact materials\/services availability and\/or pricing Partner with internal clients to identify sourcing needs, support product development projects, identify demand, supply and market trends Your background Master's degree in science and supply chain management, Business Administration, or a related field 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, preferably in a senior role Proven negotiation and contract management skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Proficiency in procurement software and tools, including SAP4HANA Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to read and interpret technical drawings Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un acquirente strategico esperto - Materiali diretti per rafforzare il nostro team di approvvigionamento globale. Gestirai un mercato di fornitura in gran parte europeo, con approvvigionamento selettivo dall'Asia e da tutto il mondo, e svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità della produzione, la nostra massima priorità. Questo ruolo è ideale per un professionista dell'approvvigionamento proattivo e con una mentalità commerciale che prospera in un ambiente internazionale complesso e ama promuovere le prestazioni dei fornitori, l'ottimizzazione dei costi e la creazione di valore a lungo termine. Come avrai un impatto Sviluppare e implementare piani di approvvigionamento strategico per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali Identificare e valutare potenziali fornitori, negoziare contratti e gestire le relazioni con i fornitori Condurre ricerche e analisi di mercato per rimanere informati sulle tendenze e sulle migliori pratiche del settore Collaborare con team interfunzionali per garantire l'allineamento delle strategie di approvvigionamento con gli obiettivi aziendali generali Monitorare e gestire le prestazioni dei fornitori, garantendo la conformità agli standard di qualità e ai tempi di consegna, e lo sviluppo continuo dei fornitori Promuovere iniziative di riduzione dei costi e identificare opportunità di miglioramento dei processi Negoziare contratti e coordinare piani di integrazione dei fornitori con i clienti interni Monitorare le dinamiche di mercato che hanno un impatto disponibilità e/o prezzi di materiali/servizi Partner con clienti interni per identificare esigenze di approvvigionamento, supportare progetti di sviluppo prodotto, identificare domanda, offerta e tendenze di mercato Il tuo background Master in scienza e gestione della catena di fornitura, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato Oltre 5 anni di esperienza nel sourcing e nell'approvvigionamento strategico, preferibilmente in un ruolo senior Comprovate capacità di negoziazione e gestione dei contratti Forti capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi Competenza in software e strumenti di procurement, incluso SAP4HANA Forti capacità di comunicazione e interpersonali Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici Ottima conoscenza Tedesco e inglese Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Wir suchen einen erfahrenen strategischen Einkäufer – Direct Materials, um unser globales Beschaffungsteam zu verstärken. Sie verwalten einen weitgehend europäischen Zuliefermarkt mit selektiver Beschaffung aus Asien und der ganzen Welt und spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Produktionsverfügbarkeit, die für uns oberste Priorität hat. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen proaktiven, kaufmännisch denkenden Beschaffungsexperten, der in einem komplexen, internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich ist und Spaß daran hat, die Lieferantenleistung, Kostenoptimierung und langfristige Wertschöpfung voranzutreiben. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie strategische Beschaffungspläne, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Identifizieren und bewerten Sie potenzielle Lieferanten, verhandeln Sie Verträge und verwalten Sie Lieferantenbeziehungen. Führen Sie Marktforschung und Analysen durch, um über Branchentrends und Best Practices auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben. Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um die Ausrichtung der Beschaffungsstrategien an den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen sicherzustellen. Überwachen und verwalten Sie die Lieferantenleistung, stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards und Lieferfristen sowie eine kontinuierliche Lieferantenentwicklung sicher. Treiben Sie Kostensenkungsinitiativen voran und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Prozessverbesserungen. Verhandeln Sie Verträge und koordinieren Sie Lieferantenintegrationspläne mit internen Kunden. Überwachen Sie die Marktdynamik, die Auswirkungen hat Verfügbarkeit und/oder Preisgestaltung von Materialien/Dienstleistungen Arbeiten Sie mit internen Kunden zusammen, um Beschaffungsbedürfnisse zu ermitteln, Produktentwicklungsprojekte zu unterstützen, Nachfrage, Angebot und Markttrends zu ermitteln. Ihr Hintergrund. Master-Abschluss in Naturwissenschaften und Lieferkettenmanagement, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in strategischer Beschaffung und Beschaffung, vorzugsweise in einer leitenden Position. Nachgewiesene Verhandlungs- und Vertragsmanagementfähigkeiten. Starke Analyse- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in Beschaffungssoftware und -tools, einschließlich SAP4HANA. Starke Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen zu lesen und zu interpretieren. Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous recherchons un acheteur stratégique expérimenté – Direct Materials pour renforcer notre équipe d'approvisionnement mondiale. Vous gérerez un marché d'approvisionnement en grande partie européen, avec un approvisionnement sélectif en provenance d'Asie et du monde entier, et jouerez un rôle essentiel pour garantir la disponibilité de la production, notre priorité absolue. Ce rôle est idéal pour un professionnel du sourcing proactif et à l'esprit commercial qui s'épanouit dans un environnement international complexe et aime stimuler la performance des fournisseurs, l'optimisation des coûts et la création de valeur à long terme. Comment vous aurez un impact Développer et mettre en œuvre des plans d'approvisionnement stratégiques pour atteindre les objectifs commerciaux Identifier et évaluer les fournisseurs potentiels, négocier des contrats et gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs Mener des études et des analyses de marché pour rester informé des tendances et des meilleures pratiques du secteur Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer l'alignement des stratégies d'approvisionnement avec les objectifs commerciaux globaux Surveiller et gérer les performances des fournisseurs, en garantissant le respect des normes de qualité et des délais de livraison, ainsi que le développement continu des fournisseurs Piloter des initiatives de réduction des coûts et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des processus Négocier des contrats et coordonner les plans d'intégration des fournisseurs avec les clients internes Surveiller la dynamique du marché qui a un impact sur la disponibilité des matériaux/services et/ou tarification Collaborez avec des clients internes pour identifier les besoins d'approvisionnement, soutenir les projets de développement de produits, identifier la demande, l'offre et les tendances du marché. Votre formation Master en sciences et gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en approvisionnement stratégique et en approvisionnement, de préférence dans un poste de direction. Compétences avérées en négociation et en gestion de contrats. Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner 1 year contract (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We're looking for a  Talent Acquisition Partner  to join our dynamic team and support our German-speaking market. In this role, you'll work closely local stakeholders and colleagues to attract top talent, drive local initiatives, and elevate candidate experience. If you're passionate about recruitment and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you! How you'll make an impact Drive end-to-end recruitment for roles on the German-speaking market across multiple functions and Business Units Act as an advisor to hiring managers, providing market insights and talent solutions Partner with local HR and business stakeholders to work actively on their hiring needs and build proactive pipelines Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion in all hiring practices Represent the company at external events and build strong employer branding initiatives Your background At least 3-5 years of experience in talent acquisition in a similar role ideally combined with experience working in an international or matrixed environment Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across all levels of the organization Good understanding of German-speaking labor market is mandatory Deep understanding of sourcing strategies, interview techniques, and assessment tools Fluency in English and German is mandatory (C1 level or mother tongue) Passionate about people, data-driven decision-making, and delivering results

• Stiamo cercando un partner per l'acquisizione di talenti che si unisca al nostro team dinamico e supporti il ​​nostro mercato di lingua tedesca. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen Talent Acquisition Partner, der sich unserem dynamischen Team anschließt und unseren deutschsprachigen Markt unterstützt. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie eng mit lokalen Stakeholdern und Kollegen zusammen, um Top-Talente anzuziehen, lokale Initiativen voranzutreiben und die Erfahrung der Kandidaten zu verbessern. Wenn Sie sich für die Personalbeschaffung begeistern und in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umfeld erfolgreich sein möchten, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören! Wie Sie etwas bewirken können: Fördern Sie die End-to-End-Rekrutierung für Rollen auf dem deutschsprachigen Markt über mehrere Funktionen und Geschäftsbereiche hinweg. Sie fungieren als Berater für Einstellungsmanager und bieten Markteinblicke und Talentlösungen. Arbeiten Sie mit lokalen HR- und Geschäftsinteressenvertretern zusammen, um aktiv an deren Einstellungsbedürfnissen zu arbeiten und proaktive Pipelines aufzubauen. Fördern Sie Diversität, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion in allen Einstellungspraktiken. Repräsentieren Sie das Unternehmen bei externen Veranstaltungen und bauen Sie starke Employer-Branding-Initiativen auf. Ihr Hintergrund. Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Talentakquise in einer ähnlichen Rolle, idealerweise kombiniert mit Berufserfahrung in einem internationalen oder heterogenen Umfeld. Starke Stakeholder-Management- und Einflussfähigkeiten auf allen Ebenen der Organisation. Gute Kenntnisse des deutschsprachigen Arbeitsmarktes sind zwingend erforderlich. Tiefes Verständnis von Beschaffungsstrategien, Interviewtechniken und Bewertungsinstrumenten. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sind obligatorisch (C1-Niveau oder Muttersprache). Leidenschaft für Menschen, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und die Lieferung von Ergebnissen
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous recherchons un partenaire en acquisition de talents pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique et soutenir notre marché germanophone. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes et les collègues locaux pour attirer les meilleurs talents, piloter des initiatives locales et améliorer l'expérience des candidats. Si vous êtes passionné par le recrutement et que vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement collaboratif au rythme rapide, nous serions ravis d'avoir de vos nouvelles ! Comment vous aurez un impact Piloter le recrutement de bout en bout pour des postes sur le marché germanophone dans plusieurs fonctions et unités commerciales Agir en tant que conseiller auprès des responsables du recrutement, en fournissant des informations sur le marché et des solutions en matière de talents Collaborer avec les parties prenantes locales des ressources humaines et des entreprises pour travailler activement sur leurs besoins d'embauche et créer des pipelines proactifs Promouvoir la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans toutes les pratiques d'embauche Représenter l'entreprise lors d'événements externes et créer de solides initiatives de marque employeur Votre expérience Au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans l'acquisition de talents dans un rôle similaire, idéalement combinée avec une expérience de travail dans un environnement international ou environnement matriciel Solides compétences en matière de gestion des parties prenantes et d'influence à tous les niveaux de l'organisation Une bonne compréhension du marché du travail germanophone est obligatoire Une compréhension approfondie des stratégies de sourcing, des techniques d'entretien et des outils d'évaluation La maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand est obligatoire (niveau C1 ou langue maternelle) Passionné par les gens, la prise de décision basée sur les données et l'obtention de résultats

jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist to join out team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical or commercial education background. Bachelor's\/Master's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering Minimum of 3 years of experience in tender management, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. L'unità Service è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale di sistemi di interruttori automatici per generatori (GCB) e quadri isolati in gas (GIS), inclusa formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi a valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza attivo a livello globale, apprezzerai il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione versatile e orientata alla pratica in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Ti aspetta una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere. Le candidature senior e junior sono benvenute! Come avrai un impatto Gestisci cantieri multiculturali in tutto il mondo per quadri isolati in gas per il livello di tensione di 110 KV - 550 KV. Responsabile della corretta esecuzione dell'installazione \/ manutenzione \/ riparazione in loco nel rispetto delle scadenze contrattuali e in conformità con i requisiti legali locali. Responsabile della qualità del lavoro svolto in cantiere attraverso il controllo di qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. Condurre formazione sul prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (facoltativo). Coordinamento della manodopera locale. Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting periodico al project management. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento dei processi e adottare in modo proattivo misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco. Il tuo background Apprendistato completato nel settore delle costruzioni metalliche, dell'industria elettrica o automobilistica o simili Conoscenze di base in ingegneria elettrica sono un requisito auspicabile, ulteriore formazione in ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio Esperienza lavorativa nel settore dell'assemblaggio e della messa in servizio è un vantaggio Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e buona conoscenza dell'inglese, almeno B2 Disponibilità per incarichi nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con fino al 90% di tempo di viaggio Giocatore di squadra flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Attitudine per soluzioni pragmatiche e non convenzionali con elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza Maggiori informazioni su di noi Entusiasmante e compiti diversificati con grande libertà creativa Interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo Attività/progetti interessanti e molto vari, compresi incarichi off-shore Team ben consolidato e dinamico Cultura aziendale aperta Un pacchetto di vantaggi interessante che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, nonché voce in capitolo nella scelta dell'alloggio

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, ist weltweit als Spezialist für Stromübertragung und -verteilung bekannt. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After-Sales-Support von Generatorleistungsschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) verantwortlich, einschließlich Schulung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, geplanter Wartung, Mehrwertdiensten, Fehlerbehebung, Erweiterungen, Nachrüstungen und Austausch. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege in unserem weltweit tätigen Serviceteam schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung im In- und Ausland leiten Sie neue GIS-Installationen rund um den Globus. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch anspruchsvolle Position in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Es erwartet Sie ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können. Sowohl Senior- als auch Junior-Bewerbungen sind willkommen! Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Leitung multikultureller Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für die Spannungsebene 110KV – 550KV. Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Installations-/Wartungs-/Reparaturarbeiten vor Ort unter Einhaltung der vertraglichen Fristen und in Übereinstimmung mit den lokalen gesetzlichen
• Anforderungen. Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort geleisteten Arbeit durch Qualitätskontrolle und Bewertung der Fähigkeiten des örtlichen Hilfspersonals. Führen Sie Produktschulungen vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation durch (optional). Koordination der örtlichen Arbeitskräfte. Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Projektmanagement. Tragen Sie aktiv zu Prozessverbesserungen bei und ergreifen Sie proaktiv Maßnahmen, um die Effizienz der Aktivitäten vor Ort zu steigern. Ihr Werdegang Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilindustrie o.ä. Grundkenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik sind wünschenswert, eine Weiterbildung in der Elektrotechnik ist von Vorteil Berufserfahrung in der Montage & Inbetriebnahme ist von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und insbesondere internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 90 % Reisezeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Gespür für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungen mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche
• Aufgaben mit großer Kreativität Freiräume Attraktive Ausbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Interessante und sehr abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten/Projekte, auch im Ausland. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, est reconnu dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. L'unité de service est responsable du support après-vente mondial des systèmes de disjoncteurs de générateur (GCB) et des appareillages à isolation gazeuse (GIS), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, la maintenance programmée, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, les extensions, les mises à niveau et les remplacements. Le service est la clé du succès. En tant que collègue de notre équipe de service active à l'échelle mondiale, vous apprécierez le travail indépendant, varié et axé sur les solutions. Après une formation polyvalente et pratique en Suisse et à l'étranger, vous dirigerez de nouvelles installations SIG dans le monde entier. Un poste techniquement stimulant dans un environnement multiculturel vous attend. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et y évoluer. Les candidatures seniors comme juniors sont les bienvenues ! Comment vous aurez un impact Gérer des chantiers de construction multiculturels dans le monde entier pour des appareillages à isolation gazeuse pour le niveau de tension de 110KV à 550KV. Responsable de la bonne exécution des installations/maintenance/réparations sur site dans le respect des délais contractuels et dans le respect des exigences légales locales. Responsable de la qualité du travail effectué sur site par le contrôle de la qualité et l'évaluation des compétences du personnel de soutien local. Organiser une formation produit sur site sur le produit et pendant l'installation (facultatif). Coordination du travail local. Contrôle des coûts des ressources utilisées et reporting régulier à la direction du projet. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration des processus et prendre des mesures de manière proactive pour augmenter l'efficacité des activités sur site. Votre parcours Un apprentissage terminé dans l'industrie de la construction métallique, électrique ou automobile, ou similaire Des connaissances de base en génie électrique sont indispensables, une formation continue en génie électrique est un avantage Une expérience professionnelle dans le montage et la mise en service est un avantage Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, au moins B2 Volonté pour des missions nationales et surtout internationales dans le monde entier avec jusqu'à 90 % de temps de trajet Esprit d'équipe flexible, résilient et communicatif Flair pour des solutions pragmatiques et non conventionnelles avec des normes de qualité et de sécurité élevées. une grande liberté de création Des opportunités de formation et d'évolution attractives Des activités/projets intéressants et très variés, y compris des missions off-shore Une équipe bien établie et dynamique Une culture d'entreprise ouverte Un ensemble d'avantages sociaux attractifs comprenant les frais fixes, de déplacement et de repas, ainsi qu'un droit à parole dans le choix de l'hébergement

jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
