jobs.title: High Voltage Testing Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali nel settore elettrico, tra cui la generazione di energia, la trasmissione e la distribuzione, si affidano alle nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia Bushing ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando un ingegnere ad alta tensione per unirsi al nostro team di test ad alta tensione presso la nostra fabbrica di boccole MICAFIL. Se siete appassionati di test ad alta tensione e volete contribuire attivamente al futuro dei nostri processi produttivi, questa è la vostra opportunità di fare un impatto reale. Come farete un piano di impatto ed eseguire test di tipo elettrico e termico, nonché test speciali su boccole ad alta tensione (in-house ed esternamente), prendendo in considerazione le risorse disponibili e budget Assist e lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), inclusi i FAT interni con i clienti Assicurare la piena funzionalità e la disponibilità di tre laboratori ad alta tensione in collaborazione con il team Lead e gestire i progetti relativi al laboratorio Garantire la conformità delle apparecchiature e del personale attraverso la tracciabilità Nell'ambito del reparto Operazioni, sostenere attivamente e contribuire alle attività aziendali quotidiane Corso di laurea o Master in Ingegneria Elettrica o equivalente Esperienza professionale in tecnologia ad alta tensione, test o macchine elettriche, idealmente in un ambiente produttivo o industriale Solida comprensione di ISO 9001 e ISO 17025 Business-fluent tedesco e buon inglese, sia scritto e parlato Forte spirito di squadra, alta competenza sociale, e il piacere di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist ein weltweiter Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Namhafte internationale Unternehmen in der Elektroindustrie – einschließlich Stromerzeugung, -übertragung und -verteilung – vertrauen unseren Lösungen. Wir sind weltweit führend in der Hochspannungsdurchführungstechnik. Um unseren Betrieb zu stärken, suchen wir einen Hochspannungsprüfingenieur, der sich unserem Hochspannungsprüfteam in unserer MICAFIL-Buchsenfabrik anschließt. Wenn Sie sich für Hochspannungstests begeistern und aktiv zur Zukunft unserer Produktionsprozesse beitragen möchten, ist dies Ihre Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewirken. Wie Sie einen Impact Plan erstellen und elektrische und thermische Typtests sowie spezielle Tests an Hochspannungsdurchführungen durchführen (intern und extern), unter Berücksichtigung der verfügbaren Ressourcen und des Budgets Assist und Lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), einschließlich interner FATs mit Kunden Sicherstellen der vollen Funktionalität und Verfügbarkeit von drei Hochspannungslabors in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team Lead und Verwaltung von Laborprojekten Sicherstellen der Sicherheit von Ausrüstung und Personal durch Schulungen, Anweisungen und Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards Sichere Qualität, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Einhaltung von Durchführungsprozessschritten durch Prozessanweisungen Führen Sie Routine-, Typ- und spezielle Tests durch Continuous Challenge und Verbesserung von Verfahren und Anweisungen als Teil von Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) Als Teil der Operations-Abteilung aktiv unterstützen und zur täglichen Geschäftstätigkeit beitragen Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in Hochspannungstechnik, Testen oder elektrischen Maschinen, idealerweise in einer Produktions- oder Industrieumgebung Solides Verständnis von ISO 9001 und ISO 17025 Business-Fluent Deutsch und gutes Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen Starker Teamgeist, hohe soziale Kompetenz und Freude an der Arbeit in einem multikulturellen Umfeld Flexible Denkweise mit einer starken Begeisterung für Technologie Proaktiver und lösungsorientierter Ansatz zur Problemlösung Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est un leader technologique mondial dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. Des entreprises internationales renommées dans l'industrie électrique – y compris la production, le transport et la distribution d'électricité – font confiance à nos solutions. Nous détenons une position de leader mondial dans la technologie de douille haute tension. Pour renforcer nos opérations, nous cherchons un ingénieur de test haute tension pour rejoindre notre équipe de test haute tension à notre usine de douille MICAFIL. Si vous êtes passionné par les tests à haute tension et que vous voulez contribuer activement à l'avenir de nos processus de production, c'est l'occasion de faire un impact réel. Planifier et exécuter des essais de type électrique et thermique ainsi que des essais spéciaux sur les douilles à haute tension (internes et externes), en tenant compte des ressources et du budget disponibles Assister et diriger les essais d'acceptation en usine (TAF), y compris les TAF internes avec les clients Assurer la pleine fonctionnalité et la disponibilité de trois laboratoires à haute tension en collaboration avec l'équipe Diriger et gérer des projets liés aux laboratoires Assurer la sécurité de l'équipement et du personnel grâce à la formation, aux instructions et au respect des normes de sécurité Assurer la qualité, la traçabilité et la conformité des étapes du processus de douilles au moyen d'instructions de processus Effectuer des essais de routine, de type et spéciaux selon les besoins Définer continuellement et améliorer les procédures et les instructions dans le cadre des processus d'amélioration continue Dans le cadre du département des Opérations, appuyer activement et contribuer aux activités quotidiennes Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique ou équivalent Expérience professionnelle en technologie à haute tension, essais ou machines électriques, idéalement dans un environnement de production ou industriel Connaissance solide de l'ISO 9001 et de l'ISO 17025 Allemand et bon anglais, écrits et parlés Esprit d'équipe fort, haute compétence sociale et plaisir de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel Un état d'esprit flexible avec un grand enthousiasme pour la technologie Une approche proactive et axée sur la solution de problèmes Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Prozess- und Anlagentechniker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position  Für unsere Industrie 4.0-fähige Produktion von Leistungshalbleitern suchen wir eine engagierte und technisch versierte Persönlichkeit als Process & Equipment Technician.  Mit deinem Know-how in Systemtechnik und Automatisierung sorgst du für eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit, behebst Störungen, treibst Verbesserungen voran und unterstützt deine Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Fragestellungen. Gemeinsam mit dem Engineering-Team bringst du unsere Fertigung auf das nächste Level und begleitest die Integration neuer Anlagen in laufende Produktionsprozesse.  Das kannst du bewirken  Kalibrierung, Wartung und Instandhaltung von Anlagen und Komponenten  Eigenständige Fehlersuche und -behebung an komplexen Produktionssystemen (2.\/3. Level)  Präventive und zustandsabhängige Instandhaltung, um Stillstände zu minimieren  Dokumentation und Kommunikation des Anlagenzustands und technischer Anpassungen  Überwachung der Prozesskonformität und Qualitätskontrolle (SPC)  Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering und Support  Schulung und Unterstützung von Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Themen  Sicherstellung der Arbeitssicherheit in allen Tätigkeiten  Das bringst du mit  Abgeschlossene Ausbildung EFZ als Automatiker\/in, Elektroniker\/in oder Polymechaniker\/in  Fundierte elektrotechnische Grundausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung als Systemtechniker\/in  Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung oder Automatisierung von Produktionsanlagen  Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Steuerungstechnik, Pneumatik und\/oder Roboterprogrammierung  Strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise   Gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und Englischkenntnisse (B2)  Mehr über uns  Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen  Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen  Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sulla posizione
• Cerchiamo una personalità impegnata e tecnicamente esperta come tecnico di processo e apparecchiature per la nostra produzione di semiconduttori di potenza compatibile con l'Industria 4.0. Con il tuo know-how nella tecnologia e nell'automazione dei sistemi, garantirai un'elevata disponibilità del sistema, risolverai guasti, promuoverai miglioramenti e supporterai i tuoi colleghi con domande tecniche. Insieme al team di ingegneri, porterai la nostra produzione al livello successivo e sosterrai l'integrazione di nuovi sistemi nei processi di produzione in corso. Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Calibrazione, manutenzione e riparazione di sistemi e componenti Ricerca guasti indipendente e risoluzione dei problemi su sistemi produttivi complessi (2°/3° Livello) Manutenzione preventiva e dipendente dalle condizioni per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo Documentazione e comunicazione dello stato dell'impianto e degli adeguamenti tecnici Monitoraggio della conformità del processo e del controllo qualità (SPC) Implementazione di misure di miglioramento in collaborazione con ingegneria e supporto Formazione e supporto dei colleghi su argomenti tecnici Garantire la sicurezza sul lavoro in tutte le attività Cosa portate con voi Formazione EFZ completata come ingegnere di automazione, ingegnere elettronico o ingegnere polimeccanico Solida formazione di base in elettrotecnica, possibilmente con perfezionamento come tecnico di sistema Esperienza pluriennale nella manutenzione o automazione di sistemi di produzione Molto buona conoscenza della tecnologia di controllo, della pneumatica e/o della programmazione dei robot Metodo di lavoro strutturato, analitico e indipendente Buona conoscenza del tedesco (C1) e dell'inglese (B2) Maggiori informazioni su di noi Lavoro sicuro in un'azienda orientata al futuro Un team collegiale con processi decisionali brevi Condizioni di impiego e opportunità di sviluppo interessanti
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position We are looking for a committed and technically experienced personality as a Process & Equipment Technician for our Industry 4.0-capable production of power semiconductors. With your know-how in system technology and automation, you will ensure high system availability, resolve faults, drive improvements and support your colleagues with technical questions. Together with the engineering team, you will take our production to the next level and support the integration of new systems into ongoing production processes. This is what you can achieve Calibration, maintenance and repair of systems and components Independent troubleshooting and troubleshooting on complex production systems (2nd/3rd Level) Preventive and condition-dependent maintenance to minimize downtimes Documentation and communication of the system status and technical adjustments Monitoring of process conformity and quality control (SPC) Implementation of improvement measures in collaboration with engineering and support Training and support of colleagues on technical topics Ensuring occupational safety in all activities
• What you bring with you Completed EFZ training as an automation engineer, electronics engineer or polymechanic Engineer Sound basic electrical engineering training, ideally with further training as a system technician Several years of experience in the maintenance or automation of production systems Very good knowledge of control technology, pneumatics and/or robot programming Structured, analytical and independent way of working Good knowledge of German (C1) and English (B2) More about us Secure job in a future-oriented company A collegial team with short decision-making processes Attractive employment conditions and development opportunities

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Nous recherchons une personnalité engagée et techniquement expérimentée en tant que technicien en procédés et équipements pour notre production de semi-conducteurs de puissance adaptée à l'industrie 4.0. Grâce à votre savoir-faire en matière de technologie système et d'automatisation, vous garantissez une disponibilité élevée du système, résolvez les pannes, pilotez les améliorations et assistez vos collègues pour les questions techniques. En collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie, vous ferez passer notre production au niveau supérieur et soutiendrez l'intégration de nouveaux systèmes dans les processus de production en cours. C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser Étalonnage, maintenance et réparation de systèmes et de composants Dépannage indépendant et dépannage sur des systèmes de production complexes (2e/3e Niveau) Maintenance préventive et conditionnelle pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt Documentation et communication de l'état du système et des ajustements techniques Surveillance de la conformité des processus et du contrôle qualité (SPC) Mise en œuvre de mesures d'amélioration en collaboration avec l'ingénierie et le support Formation et soutien des collègues sur des sujets techniques Assurer la sécurité au travail dans toutes les activités Ce que vous apportez avec vous Formation EFZ terminée en tant qu'automaticien, électronicien ou polymécanicien Bonne formation de base en électrotechnique, idéalement avec une formation complémentaire en tant que technicien système Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la maintenance ou l'automatisation de systèmes de production Très bien connaissance de la technologie de commande, de la pneumatique et/ou de la programmation de robots Mode de travail structuré, analytique et indépendant Bonne connaissance de l'allemand (C1) et de l'anglais (B2) En savoir plus sur nous Un emploi sûr dans une entreprise tournée vers l'avenir Une équipe collégiale avec des processus de décision courts Des conditions de travail et des opportunités de développement attrayantes

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich GIS (gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. Als Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist unterstützt du aktiv bei der Analyse und nachhaltigen Verbesserung von Qualitäts- und Produktionsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen internen Fachbereichen zusammen, bringst neue Perspektiven ein und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Probleme systematisch zu identifizieren und zu lösen.   Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Qualitätsmeldungen und Produktionsproblemen Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Troubleshooting-Prozessen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering und Planung Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Produktions- und Qualitätsdaten Dokumentation von Maßnahmen und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsinitiativen Mitarbeit bei internen Reviews und Audits   Das bringst du mit Laufendes Studium oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Industrial Engineering, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar Erste praktische Erfahrung im industriellen Umfeld von Vorteil, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Produktion, Industrialisierung, Digitalisierung oder Prozessautomatisierung Starkes Interesse an Produktionsprozessen, Qualität und Problemanalyse sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Grundkenntnisse in SAP, DSP, MES oder Datenanalyse-Tools sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

jobs.title: R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on  location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv zum reibungslosen Materialfluss beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Warehouse Specialist spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle in unserem Logistikbereich und sorgst dafür, dass Material und Waren termingerecht, sicher und korrekt bewegt, gelagert und bereitgestellt werden. Mit deinem Engagement trägst du dazu bei, Ordnung, Effizienz und Qualität in unseren Lagerprozessen sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Administrative Tätigkeiten Erfassen und Pflegen von Daten im ERP-System Erstellen von Lieferscheinen, Versandpapieren und internen Dokumenten Bearbeitung von Bestellungen und Rückmeldungen Telefonische und schriftliche Korrespondenz mit internen Stellen und Lieferanten Unterstützung der Logistikleitung bei Auswertungen und Reportings Logistik & Lager Aktive Mitarbeit bei Prozessoptimierung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (KVP) Einlagerung der Ware nach vorgegebenen Prozessen Kommissionieren, Verpacken und Versandvorbereitung Be- und Entladen von LKW Durchführung von Inventuren Ordnung und Sauberkeit im Lager sicherstellen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker\/in EFZ oder mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Logistik Erfahrung mit administrativen Tätigkeiten von Vorteil Gute PC-Kenntnisse (MS Office, ERP-Systeme SAP \/S4 HANA) Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Körperlich belastbar und teamfähig Staplerausweis Mehr über uns Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Ti piacerebbe lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, assumerti responsabilità e contribuire attivamente al regolare flusso dei materiali? Allora sei nel posto giusto. In qualità di specialista di magazzino, svolgi un ruolo cruciale nella nostra area logistica e garantisci che materiali e merci vengano spostati, immagazzinati e resi disponibili in tempo, in modo sicuro e corretto. Con il tuo impegno contribuirai a garantire ordine, efficienza e qualità nei nostri processi di magazzino. Questo è quello che puoi fare Attività amministrative Registrare e conservare i dati nel sistema ERP Creare bolle di consegna, documenti di spedizione e documenti interni Elaborare ordini e feedback Corrispondenza telefonica e scritta con reparti interni e fornitori Supportare la gestione della logistica con valutazioni e report Logistica e magazzino Partecipazione attiva all'ottimizzazione dei processi e al miglioramento continuo (CIP) Stoccaggio delle merci secondo processi specificati Prelievo, imballaggio e preparazione della spedizione Carico e scarico dei camion Effettuare inventari Ordine e pulizia nell'ambiente Garantire lo stoccaggio Questo è ciò che porti con te Formazione completata come uno specialista della logistica EFZ o pluriennale esperienza nel settore della logistica L'esperienza nelle attività amministrative è un vantaggio Buona conoscenza del PC (MS Office, sistemi ERP SAP \/S4 HANA) Ottima conoscenza del tedesco parlato e scritto, la conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio Modo di lavorare indipendente, strutturato e affidabile Fisicamente resiliente e capace di lavorare in squadra Patente per carrello elevatore Di più su di noi Lavoro sicuro in un'azienda orientata al futuro Un team collegiale con processi decisionali brevi Condizioni di lavoro interessanti e opportunità di sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en: About the position Would you like to work in a dynamic environment, take on responsibility and actively contribute to the smooth flow of materials? Then you've come to the right place. As a Warehouse Specialist, you play a crucial role in our logistics area and ensure that materials and goods are moved, stored and made available on time, safely and correctly. With your commitment, you will help ensure order, efficiency and quality in our warehouse processes. This is what you can do Administrative activities Recording and maintaining data in the ERP system Creating delivery notes, shipping documents and internal documents Processing orders and feedback Telephone and written correspondence with internal departments and suppliers Supporting the logistics management with evaluations and reports Logistics & warehouse Active participation in process optimization and continuous improvement (CIP) Storage of goods according to specified processes Picking, packing and shipping preparation Loading and unloading of trucks Carrying out inventories Order and cleanliness in the Ensuring storage This is what you bring with you Completed training as a logistics specialist EFZ or several years of experience in logistics Experience with administrative activities is an advantage Good PC knowledge (MS Office, ERP systems SAP \/S4 HANA) Very good knowledge of spoken and written German, knowledge of English is an advantage Independent, structured and reliable way of working Physically resilient and able to work in a team Forklift license More about us Secure job in a future-oriented company A collegial team with short decision-making processes Attractive employment conditions and development opportunities

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy High Voltage Service supports customers worldwide with after-sales services for generator circuit breakers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS). The team works closely with customers globally on installation, commissioning, maintenance, retrofitting and modernization. In this role, you will be closely involved with the product and work on construction sites around the world. You will take on responsibility, contribute your own ideas and gain valuable international experience through extended assignments abroad. Continuous learning, teamwork and professional development are an integral part of your daily work. How you'll make an impact Commission and test GIS systems in close cooperation with customer representatives Verify correct system functionality according to specifications and scope of supply Identify deviations and initiate corrective actions with project stakeholders Ensure compliance with site safety regulations and procedures at all times Apply and monitor environmental protection measures on site Participate in site meetings with relevant stakeholders Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanics, or a related field Initial experience in commissioning and\/or control system engineering Fluent German and English communication skills Ability to work independently under challenging site conditions Willingness to travel globally up to 90% of working time More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable  only for Poland location align with local law regulations

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del laboratorio – Test ad alta tensione 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de laboratoire – Tests haute tension 80 - 100 % (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Tra i nostri clienti figurano tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali dell'industria elettrica, attive nella produzione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Abbiamo una posizione di primo piano nel settore delle boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo altamente responsabile e dinamico, guiderai il nostro team di laboratorio presso MICAFIL a Zurigo-Altstetten (ZH) e garantirai di rafforzare ulteriormente la nostra competitività e sviluppare la nostra filiale svizzera per soddisfare la crescita del mercato globale nel campo dell'energia. In questo importante ruolo, porterai avanti continuamente i processi efficienti e innovativi dei nostri 3 diversi laboratori insieme a un team forte. Se hai una passione per la leadership e i test ad alta tensione, ti offriamo il palcoscenico per realizzare un cambiamento reale e plasmare attivamente il futuro dei nostri processi produttivi. Come avrai un impatto Guidare il team di laboratorio, inclusa la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team (15 FTE) e fungere da punto di contatto per i test HV presso Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Garantire la conformità agli standard di sicurezza e qualità (IEC\/IEEE) Analizzare e implementare processi aziendali e di produzione efficienti per aumentare sicurezza, qualità e produttività Garantire risultati elevati attraverso procedure di test affidabili ad alta tensione (AC, DC, impulso, scarica parziale) Identificare e integrare nuove tecnologie e migliori pratiche per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme a il tuo team e il nostro team di ingegneria di processo Collaborare strettamente con la pianificazione, il controllo qualità, la logistica, altri reparti di produzione e le parti interessate pertinenti per la progettazione e il miglioramento olistico del processo Essere responsabile delle istruzioni ottimali di lavoro e manutenzione e di altre normative pertinenti (ad es. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Sviluppare e monitorare i più importanti indicatori chiave di prestazione (KPI) per misurare il successo e riferirli al responsabile delle operazioni In qualità di People Manager, sarai responsabile di garantire la conformità alle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne ed interne applicabili Il tuo background Apprendistato tecnico e qualifiche (laurea \/ master) nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o equivalente Diversi anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership simile (test ad alta tensione\/tecnologia di isolamento\/ingegneria energetica) Solida conoscenza dell'alta tensione sistemi, generatori e sistemi di automazione Solida conoscenza del lean management, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi Comprovata esperienza nella guida e nella motivazione di team interfunzionali Forti capacità di problem solving e un approccio al processo decisionale basato sui dati combinati con una forte attenzione alla sicurezza Eccellenti capacità di gestione del tempo, comunicazione e organizzazione Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Zu unseren Kunden zählen alle namhaften internationalen Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die in der Stromerzeugung, -übertragung und -verteilung tätig sind. Im Bereich Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen nehmen wir weltweit eine Spitzenposition ein. In dieser äußerst verantwortungsvollen und dynamischen Rolle leiten Sie unser Laborteam bei MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) und sorgen dafür, dass wir unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit weiter stärken und unsere Schweizer Niederlassung weiterentwickeln, um dem globalen Marktwachstum im Bereich Energie gerecht zu werden. In dieser wichtigen Rolle treiben Sie gemeinsam mit einem starken Team die effizienten und innovativen Prozesse unserer drei verschiedenen Labore kontinuierlich voran. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Führung und Hochspannungsprüfung haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Bühne, um echte Veränderungen herbeizuführen und die Zukunft unserer Produktionsprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Führen Sie das Laborteam, einschließlich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung (15 FTE), und fungieren Sie als Ansprechpartner für HV-Tests bei Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL. Stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards (IEC\/IEEE) sicher. Analysieren und implementieren Sie effiziente Produktions- und Geschäftsprozesse, um Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu erhöhen. Sorgen Sie für eine hohe Leistung durch zuverlässige Hochspannungstestverfahren (AC, DC, Impuls, Teilentladung). Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team und unserem Prozesstechnik-Team Arbeiten Sie eng mit Planung, Qualitätssicherung, Logistik, anderen Produktionsabteilungen und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche Prozessgestaltung und -verbesserung zu erreichen. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Entwickeln und überwachen Sie die wichtigsten Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), um den Erfolg zu messen und an den Betriebsleiter zu berichten. Als People Manager sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die Einhaltung geltender externer und interner Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien sicherzustellen. Ihr Hintergrund. Technische Ausbildung und Qualifikationen (Bachelor/Master) im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Führungsposition (Hochspannungsprüfung/Isolationstechnik/Energietechnik). Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungssystemen, Generatoren usw Automatisierungssysteme Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lean Management, Six Sigma und anderen Prozessoptimierungsmethoden Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung und Motivation funktionsübergreifender Teams Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein datengesteuerter Entscheidungsansatz kombiniert mit einem starken Fokus auf Sicherheit Ausgezeichnetes Zeitmanagement, Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Composants est le leader technologique dans la conception et la fabrication de traversées de transformateurs haute tension. Toutes les entreprises internationales renommées de l'industrie électrique, actives dans la production, le transport et la distribution d'électricité comptent parmi nos clients. Être responsable des instructions de travail et de maintenance optimales et d'autres réglementations pertinentes (par ex. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Développer et surveiller les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) les plus importants pour mesurer le succès et en rendre compte au responsable des opérations. En tant que People Manager, vous serez responsable de garantir le respect des réglementations, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Votre formation Apprentissage et qualifications techniques (Bachelor \/ Master) dans le domaine du génie électrique ou équivalent Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un poste de direction similaire (Tests haute tension\/Technologie d'isolation\/Ingénierie de l'énergie) Solides connaissances dans les systèmes haute tension, les générateurs, et des systèmes d'automatisation Solides connaissances du Lean Management, de Six Sigma et d'autres méthodes d'optimisation des processus. Expérience avérée dans la direction et la motivation d'équipes interfonctionnelles. Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et approche de la prise de décision basée sur les données, combinées à une forte concentration sur la sécurité. Excellentes compétences en matière de gestion du temps, de communication et d'organisation. Parle couramment l'allemand et l'anglais. En savoir plus sur nous. Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.description:

descriptionByLocale.en:

You will put your theoretical knowledge from your studies - for example in methods and project management - directly into practice and gain valuable experience in the process.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de service sur le terrain (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità In qualità di tecnico dell'assistenza sul campo presso HITACHI ENERGY LTD, sei responsabile dell'installazione, manutenzione e riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente presso la sede del cliente in Svizzera. Garantite la prestazione e la disponibilità ottimali dei sistemi e quindi fornite un contributo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti. Questo è quello che puoi fare: Effettuare installazioni, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazione su prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, in particolare nei settori dell'alta tensione, della trasmissione e distribuzione dell'energia. Analisi degli errori e risoluzione dei problemi su impianti e sistemi elettrici complessi. Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni utilizzo. Consulenza ai clienti su questioni tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione. Formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione dei sistemi. Rispetto delle norme di sicurezza e degli standard di qualità. Disponibilità a trasferte in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero. Partecipazione al servizio di guardia (on-call) al di fuori del normale orario di lavoro. Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze su nuovi prodotti e tecnologie. Il tuo background Formazione tecnica completata (ad esempio elettricista, ingegnere elettronico, ingegnere dell'automazione) o laurea (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia energetica). Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel servizio o nella manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore energetico. Una buona conoscenza della tecnologia dell'alta tensione, dei quadri elettrici e dei sistemi di controllo costituisce un vantaggio. Manipolazione sicura dei dispositivi di misurazione e prova. Buona conoscenza del tedesco parlato e scritto (lo svizzero tedesco costituisce un vantaggio), nonché buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese costituisce un plus. Forti capacità di problem solving e pensiero analitico. Elevato livello di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento al cliente. Patente di guida valida di categoria B. Disponibilità a orari flessibili e spostamenti. Maggiori informazioni su di noi
• Offriamo compiti interessanti e vari
• con ampio spazio alla creatività nonché interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e vari, inclusi incarichi offshore, un team ben coordinato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre beneficiate di un interessante pacchetto di servizi con indennità fisse di viaggio e vitto e il diritto di avere voce in capitolo nella scelta dell'alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer's site in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. This is what you can do: Carrying out installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and troubleshooting on complex electrical systems and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each use. Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options. Training customer personnel in handling the systems. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call duty (on-call) outside of regular working hours. Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automation engineer) or degree (e.g. electrical engineering, energy technology). Several years of professional experience in the service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry. Sound knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is an advantage. Safe handling of measuring and testing devices. Good knowledge of spoken and written German (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking. High level of initiative, sense of responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driving license category B. Willingness to work flexible hours and travel. More about us
• We offer exciting and varied
• tasks with great scope for creativity as well as attractive further training and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and varied activities and projects, including offshore assignments, a well-coordinated and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and meal allowances as well as the right to have a say in the choice of accommodation.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products is the globally recognized specialist in power transmission and distribution. The service unit is responsible for global after-sales support for generator circuit breaker systems (GCB) and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, conversions and replacement. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our global service team, you appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a varied, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will manage GIS installations and maintenance around the globe. A technically challenging position awaits you in a multicultural environment. Coordination and instruction of workers Cost control of the resources used and regular reporting to the project management Active participation in process improvements and proactively taking measures to increase the efficiency of activities on site Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry Basic electrical engineering knowledge is a must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage At least 5 years of professional experience in the assembly and commissioning area Very good knowledge of German and good English, at least B2 Willingness for national and, above all, international worldwide assignments with up to 80% travel Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solution search with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied

jobs.title: Teamleader Design Engineering - Generator Circuit Breaker 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems  Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe de disjoncteurs de générateur (GCB) et contribuez aux produits qui façonnent la fiabilité et les performances de la production d'électricité dans le monde entier. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et soutiendrez une équipe motivée de concepteurs CAO tout en collaborant étroitement avec des ingénieurs expérimentés, des fournisseurs chefs de projet et l'usine située à Oerlikon tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, depuis les premiers concepts de conception jusqu'aux initiatives d'amélioration continue. Vous aurez la chance d'avoir un réel impact en favorisant des pratiques de conception de haute qualité, en favorisant des méthodes de travail unifiées et en défendant l'excellence des processus et de la documentation. Grâce à un programme d'introduction structuré, vous gagnerez l'indépendance et la confiance nécessaires pour diriger votre équipe efficacement, tout en bénéficiant d'opportunités de formation et de développement ciblées qui soutiennent votre croissance professionnelle. Comment vous aurez un impact Coachez et dirigez une équipe de concepteurs CAO, garantissant une création, une modification et une maintenance de haute qualité des données d'ingénierie pour les systèmes et composants de disjoncteurs de générateur (taille de l'équipe env. 10 ETP) Développer/améliorer/maintenir les données de base de tous les produits GCB avec des modèles 3D, des dessins et des nomenclatures dans les systèmes CAO/PLM Mettre en œuvre des conceptions spéciales, des projets permettant de réduire les coûts et piloter l'amélioration de la qualité des produits Initier et établir des améliorations du processus de conception Assurer une collaboration efficace avec d'autres fonctions d'ingénierie, les chefs de projet et d'autres parties prenantes Contribuer à la supervision et à la formation des apprentis avec les conseillers des apprentis de l'équipe En tant que People Manager, vous serez responsable d'assurer le respect des réglementations, procédures et directives externes et internes applicables. Expérience Solide base technique en tant que concepteur senior ou formation d'ingénieur équivalente Expérience avérée et manipulation sûre des outils de CAO (de préférence Creo) Solide connaissance pratique des systèmes PLM (de préférence PTC Windchill), des rôles, de la gestion des objets et des processus de publication Expérience dans une fonction de direction d'équipe ou en tant que chef de projet d'une équipe de projet Compétences distinctes en matière d'auto-organisation, ainsi qu'un style de travail précis et indépendant Capacité à structurer le travail, prioriser les tâches et gérer plusieurs sujets de conception simultanément avec une qualité et une fiabilité élevées Esprit orienté vers l'amélioration des processus, la qualité des documents et l'établissement méthodes de travail structurées Parle couramment l'allemand et l'anglais En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Dry Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule  Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team  English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Electrical Engineer for Medium Frequency Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva and shape the future of energy. As a Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge transformer technologies in a dynamic, international environment. You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us 
• We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund

jobs.title: Commissioning & Start-Up Engineering Experienced Professional (f/m/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
The opportunity In this role, you will plan, prepare, and coordinate all pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities through to successful handover. You will develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, manuals, test procedures, and documentation, ensuring all activities meet customer, quality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with engineering, project management, and third‑party partners to resolve technical issues, obtain required approvals, and secure customer acceptance. Working independently, you will apply your technical expertise to drive safe, efficient, and compliant commissioning execution while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the wider project team. How you'll make an impact
• Carry out testing and commissioning of control and relay panels and substation automation systems across various locations in Singapore
• Execute commissioning activities safely in line with Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards, reporting hazards and near misses
• Ensure a positive customer experience and manage customer relationships professionally
• Perform commissioning according to documented processes and checklists, resolving open points and securing customer sign‑off
• Report site progress and planning and ensure efficient use of commissioning assets such as test kits and tools
• Hand over marked‑up drawings for as‑built preparation and final submission to the customer
• Identify and monitor risks in your area of responsibility, ensuring stakeholders remain informed
• Provide guidance to associate commissioning engineers and coordinate tasks with junior staff or small Your background
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands‑on experience in commissioning protection, control, or substation automation systems
• Solid knowledge of protection relays, substation communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850), and related testing tools
• Strong understanding of safety standards and compliance requirements in utility or industrial environments
• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
• Ability to interact confidently with customers, engineers, project managers, and external stakeholders
• Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work independently at customer sites More about us At Hitachi Energy, diversity and collaboration are central to how we work. We believe that bringing together different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas strengthens our teams and drives innovation. You will join a global environment where people support each other, learn from one another, and work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance: In dieser Rolle planen, bereiten und koordinieren Sie alle Vor-, Inbetriebnahme- und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten bis hin zur erfolgreichen Übergabe. Sie entwickeln und pflegen Inbetriebnahmepläne, Zeitpläne, Handbücher, Testverfahren und Dokumentationen und stellen sicher, dass alle Aktivitäten den Kunden-, Qualitäts- und behördlichen Anforderungen entsprechen. Sie arbeiten eng mit der Technik, dem Projektmanagement und Drittpartnern zusammen, um technische Probleme zu lösen, erforderliche Genehmigungen einzuholen und die Kundenakzeptanz sicherzustellen. Sie arbeiten unabhängig und setzen Ihr technisches Fachwissen ein, um eine sichere, effiziente und konforme Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme voranzutreiben, während Sie gleichzeitig zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beitragen und das breitere Projektteam unterstützen. So können Sie etwas bewirken:
• Führen Sie Tests und Inbetriebnahmen von Steuer- und Relaistafeln sowie Automatisierungssystemen für Umspannwerke an verschiedenen Standorten in Singapur durch.
• Führen Sie Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten sicher im Einklang mit den Sicherheitsstandards von Hitachi Energy und den Kunden durch, melden Sie Gefahren und Beinaheunfälle.
• Sorgen Sie für ein positives Kundenerlebnis und verwalten Sie Kundenbeziehungen professionell.
• Führen Sie Inbetriebnahmen gemäß dokumentierten Prozessen und Checklisten durch, lösen Sie offene Punkte und sichern Sie die Kundenfreigabe.
• Melden Sie den Standortfortschritt und die Planung und stellen Sie eine effiziente Nutzung von Inbetriebnahmeressourcen wie Testkits und Werkzeugen sicher.
• Übergeben Markierte Zeichnungen für die As-Built-Erstellung und die endgültige Einreichung beim Kunden.
• Identifizieren und überwachen Sie Risiken in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich, um sicherzustellen, dass die Beteiligten informiert bleiben.
• Bieten Sie Anleitungen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Inbetriebnahmeingenieuren und koordinieren Sie Aufgaben mit Nachwuchskräften oder kleinen Mitarbeitern. Ihr Hintergrund:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme von Schutz-, Steuerungs- oder Umspannwerkautomatisierungssystemen.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse über Schutzrelais, Umspannwerk-Kommunikationsprotokolle (z. B. IEC 61850) und damit verbundene Tests Werkzeuge
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Sicherheitsstandards und Compliance-Anforderungen in Versorgungs- oder Industrieumgebungen
• Erfahrung in der Interpretation von Konstruktionszeichnungen, Schaltplänen und technischer Dokumentation
• Fähigkeit, selbstbewusst mit Kunden, Ingenieuren, Projektmanagern und externen Interessengruppen zu interagieren
• Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig vor Ort beim Kunden zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy sind Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit von zentraler Bedeutung für unsere Arbeitsweise. Wir glauben, dass die Zusammenführung unterschiedlicher Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Ideen unsere Teams stärkt und Innovationen vorantreibt. Sie werden Teil eines globalen Umfelds, in dem Menschen sich gegenseitig unterstützen, voneinander lernen und zusammenarbeiten, um eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle voranzutreiben.

You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition towards a carbon-neutral future. At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories.  Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. You will foster strong relationships with key customers, utilizing their feedback to drive continuous improvement in the mechanical design platform. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing by actively distributing insights, best practices, and lessons learned to promote collaboration and continuous innovation within the team. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background You hold a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field. 5-10 years of experience in design engineering with a proven track record of leading design projects. Or a minimum of 5 years of experience in software development within the transformer industry or a comparable technical field. Solid knowledge of Creo modelling (Pro\/Program, Sheet-Metal, Family table, Interchange, Relation, Skeleton, Assembly) Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, VB, C+ or C++, with extensive experience in leveraging software development frameworks to deliver complex solutions. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the capability to perform comprehensive risk analysis.
